    209                                              class riscv_branch_instr extends riscv_instr;
    210                                                  `uvm_object_utils(riscv_branch_instr)
    211                                              
    212                                                  typedef enum logic [2:0] {
    213                                                      BEQ  = 3'b000,
    214                                                      BNE  = 3'b001,
    215                                                      BLT  = 3'b100,
    216                                                      BGE  = 3'b101,
    217                                                      BLTU = 3'b110,
    218                                                      BGEU = 3'b111
    219                                                  } branch_func_e;
    220                                              
    221                                                  rand branch_func_e func;
    222                                                  rand logic signed [12:0] offset;  // signed, bits[12:1] go into B-imm, bit0=0
    223                                              
    224                                                  constraint c_opcode  { opcode == OP_BRANCH; }
    225                                                  constraint c_offset  { offset inside {[-64:64]}; offset[0] == 0; }
    226                                                  // No writes: override parent
    227                                                  constraint c_no_x0_rd { 1; }
    228                                              
    229                                                  function new(string name = "riscv_branch_instr");
    230                                                      super.new(name);
    231                                                  endfunction
    232                                              
    233                                                  function void encode();
    234                                                      logic [12:0] o;
    235                                                      funct3 = func;
    236                                                      o      = offset;
    237                                                      // B-type encoding: imm[12|10:5] | rs2 | rs1 | funct3 | imm[4:1|11] | opcode
    238                                                      bits   = {o[12], o[10:5], rs2, rs1, funct3, o[4:1], o[11], opcode};
    239                                                  endfunction
    240                                              
    241                                                  function string to_asm();
    242                                                      return $sformatf("%-6s x%0d, x%0d, %0d", func.name(), rs1, rs2, $signed(offset));
    243                                                  endfunction
    244                                              
    245                                              endclass

    64                                                       XOR  = 10'b0_100,
    65                                                       SRL  = 10'b0_101,
    66                                                       SRA  = 10'b1_101,
    67                                                       OR   = 10'b0_110,
    68                                                       AND  = 10'b0_111
    69                                                   } r_func_e;
    70                                               
    71                                                   rand r_func_e func;
    72                                               
    73                                                   constraint c_opcode { opcode == OP_R; }
    74                                               
    75                                                   function new(string name = "riscv_r_instr");
    76                                                       super.new(name);
    77                                                   endfunction
    78                                               
    79                                                   function void encode();
    80                                                       logic f7_5;
    81                                                       logic [2:0] f3;
    82                                                       {f7_5, f3} = func;
    83                                                       funct7 = {1'b0, f7_5, 5'b0};  // bit5 is the discriminating bit (SUB/SRA=0x20, others=0x00)
    84                                                       funct3 = f3;
    85                                                       bits   = {funct7, rs2, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode};
    86                                                   endfunction
    87                                               
    88                                                   function string to_asm();
    89                                                       return $sformatf("%-6s x%0d, x%0d, x%0d",
    90                                                                        func.name(), rd, rs1, rs2);
    91                                                   endfunction
    92                                               
    93                                               endclass
    94                                               
    95                                               
    96                                               class riscv_i_alu_instr extends riscv_instr;
    97                                                   `uvm_object_utils(riscv_i_alu_instr)
    98                                               
    99                                                   typedef enum logic [3:0] {
    100                                                      ADDI  = 4'd0,
    101                                                      SLTI  = 4'd1,
    102                                                      SLTIU = 4'd2,
    103                                                      XORI  = 4'd3,
    104                                                      ORI   = 4'd4,
    105                                                      ANDI  = 4'd5,
    106                                                      SLLI  = 4'd6,
    107                                                      SRLI  = 4'd7,
    108                                                      SRAI  = 4'd8
    109                                                  } i_func_e;
    110                                              
    111                                                  rand i_func_e func;
    112                                                  rand logic [4:0] shamt;   // shift amount for shift instructions
    113                                              
    114                                                  constraint c_opcode { opcode == OP_I_ALU; }
    115                                                  constraint c_shamt  { shamt < 32; }
    116                                              
    117                                                  // Keep immediates in a small sensible range to avoid extreme values
    118                                                  constraint c_imm    { imm12 inside {[0:255]}; }
    119                                              
    120                                                  function new(string name = "riscv_i_alu_instr");
    121                                                      super.new(name);
    122                                                  endfunction
    123                                              
    124                                                  function void encode();
    125                                                      case (func)
    126                                                          ADDI:  begin funct3 = 3'b000; bits = {imm12, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode}; end
    127                                                          SLTI:  begin funct3 = 3'b010; bits = {imm12, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode}; end
    128                                                          SLTIU: begin funct3 = 3'b011; bits = {imm12, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode}; end
    129                                                          XORI:  begin funct3 = 3'b100; bits = {imm12, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode}; end
    130                                                          ORI:   begin funct3 = 3'b110; bits = {imm12, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode}; end
    131                                                          ANDI:  begin funct3 = 3'b111; bits = {imm12, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode}; end
    132                                                          SLLI:  begin funct3 = 3'b001; bits = {7'b0000000, shamt, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode}; end
    133                                                          SRLI:  begin funct3 = 3'b101; bits = {7'b0000000, shamt, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode}; end
    134                                                          SRAI:  begin funct3 = 3'b101; bits = {7'b0100000, shamt, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode}; end
    135                                                      endcase
    136                                                  endfunction
    137                                              
    138                                                  function string to_asm();
    139                                                      if (func inside {SLLI, SRLI, SRAI})
    140                                                          return $sformatf("%-6s x%0d, x%0d, %0d", func.name(), rd, rs1, shamt);
    141                                                      return $sformatf("%-6s x%0d, x%0d, %0d", func.name(), rd, rs1, $signed(imm12));
    142                                                  endfunction
    143                                              
    144                                              endclass

    147                                              class riscv_load_instr extends riscv_instr;

    159                                                  constraint c_imm    { imm12 < 12'd256; }

    168                                                  endfunction
    169                                              
    170                                                  function string to_asm();
    171                                                      return $sformatf("%-6s x%0d, %0d(x%0d)", func.name(), rd, $signed(imm12), rs1);
    172                                                  endfunction
    173

    200                                                  endfunction
    201                                              
    202                                                  function string to_asm();
    203                                                      return $sformatf("%-6s x%0d, %0d(x%0d)", func.name(), rs2, $signed(imm12), rs1);

    209                                              class riscv_branch_instr extends riscv_instr;
    210                                                  `uvm_object_utils(riscv_branch_instr)
    211                                              
    212                                                  typedef enum logic [2:0] {
    213                                                      BEQ  = 3'b000,
    214                                                      BNE  = 3'b001,
    215                                                      BLT  = 3'b100,
    216                                                      BGE  = 3'b101,
    217                                                      BLTU = 3'b110,
    218                                                      BGEU = 3'b111
    219                                                  } branch_func_e;
    220                                              
    221                                                  rand branch_func_e func;
    222                                                  rand logic signed [12:0] offset;  // signed, bits[12:1] go into B-imm, bit0=0
    223                                              
    224                                                  constraint c_opcode  { opcode == OP_BRANCH; }
    225                                                  constraint c_offset  { offset inside {[-64:64]}; offset[0] == 0; }
    226                                                  // No writes: override parent
    227                                                  constraint c_no_x0_rd { 1; }
    228                                              
    229                                                  function new(string name = "riscv_branch_instr");
    230                                                      super.new(name);
    231                                                  endfunction
    232                                              
    233                                                  function void encode();
    234                                                      logic [12:0] o;
    235                                                      funct3 = func;
    236                                                      o      = offset;
    237                                                      // B-type encoding: imm[12|10:5] | rs2 | rs1 | funct3 | imm[4:1|11] | opcode
    238                                                      bits   = {o[12], o[10:5], rs2, rs1, funct3, o[4:1], o[11], opcode};
    239                                                  endfunction
    240                                              
    241                                                  function string to_asm();
    242                                                      return $sformatf("%-6s x%0d, x%0d, %0d", func.name(), rs1, rs2, $signed(offset));
    243                                                  endfunction
    244                                              
    245                                              endclass

    252                                              
    253                                                  constraint c_imm20 { imm20 != 0; }
    254

    256                                                      super.new(name);
    257                                                  endfunction
    258

    260                                                      opcode = is_auipc ? OP_AUIPC : OP_LUI;
    261                                                      bits   = {imm20, rd, opcode};
    262                                                  endfunction

    264                                                  function string to_asm();
    265                                                      return $sformatf("%-6s x%0d, 0x%05h",

    272                                              class riscv_fp_instr extends riscv_instr;
    273                                                  `uvm_object_utils(riscv_fp_instr)
    274                                              
    275                                                  typedef enum logic [6:0] {
    276                                                      FADD  = 7'b0000000,
    277                                                      FSUB  = 7'b0000100,
    278                                                      FMUL  = 7'b0001000,
    279                                                      FDIV  = 7'b0001100,
    280                                                      FSQRT = 7'b0101100
    281                                                  } fp_func_e;
    282                                              
    283                                                  rand fp_func_e func;
    284                                              
    285                                                  constraint c_opcode  { opcode == OP_FP; }
    286                                                  // FSQRT only uses rs1
    287                                                  constraint c_fsqrt_rs2 { (func == FSQRT) -> (rs2 == 5'd0); }
    288                                              
    289                                                  function new(string name = "riscv_fp_instr");
    290                                                      super.new(name);
    291                                                  endfunction
    292                                              
    293                                                  function void encode();
    294                                                      funct7 = func;
    295                                                      funct3 = 3'b000;   // RNE rounding
    296                                                      bits   = {funct7, rs2, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode};
    297                                                  endfunction
    298                                              
    299                                                  function string to_asm();
    300                                                      if (func == FSQRT)
    301                                                          return $sformatf("FSQRT.S f%0d, f%0d", rd, rs1);
    302                                                      return $sformatf("%-8s f%0d, f%0d, f%0d", func.name(), rd, rs1, rs2);
    303                                                  endfunction
    304                                              
    305                                              endclass

    307                                              
    308                                              class riscv_fp_mem_instr extends riscv_instr;
    309                                                  `uvm_object_utils(riscv_fp_mem_instr)
    310                                              
    311                                                  rand bit is_store;
    312                                              
    313                                                  constraint c_opcode  { opcode == (is_store ? OP_FSTORE : OP_FLOAD); }
    314                                                  constraint c_imm_align { imm12[1:0] == 2'b00; imm12 < 12'd256; }
    315                                                  constraint c_no_x0_rd { 1; }   // FP dest register, not integer
    316                                              
    317                                                  function new(string name = "riscv_fp_mem_instr");
    318                                                      super.new(name);
    319                                                  endfunction
    320                                              
    321                                                  function void encode();
    322                                                      funct3 = 3'b010;  // .S (single precision)
    323                                                      if (is_store)
    324                                                          bits = {imm12[11:5], rs2, rs1, funct3, imm12[4:0], opcode};
    325                                                      else
    326                                                          bits = {imm12, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode};
    327                                                  endfunction
    328                                              
    329                                                  function string to_asm();
    330                                                      if (is_store)
    331                                                          return $sformatf("FSW    f%0d, %0d(x%0d)", rs2, $signed(imm12), rs1);
    332                                                      return $sformatf("FLW    f%0d, %0d(x%0d)", rd, $signed(imm12), rs1);
    333                                                  endfunction
    334                                              
    335                                              endclass
    5                                                typedef enum logic [6:0] {
    6                                                    OP_R      = 7'b0110011,   // ADD SUB AND OR XOR SLL SRL SRA SLT SLTU
    7                                                    OP_I_ALU  = 7'b0010011,   // ADDI ANDI ORI XORI SLTI SLTIU SLLI SRLI SRAI
    8                                                    OP_LOAD   = 7'b0000011,   // LB LH LW LBU LHU
    9                                                    OP_STORE  = 7'b0100011,   // SB SH SW
    10                                                   OP_BRANCH = 7'b1100011,   // BEQ BNE BLT BGE BLTU BGEU
    11                                                   OP_JAL    = 7'b1101111,
    12                                                   OP_JALR   = 7'b1100111,
    13                                                   OP_LUI    = 7'b0110111,
    14                                                   OP_AUIPC  = 7'b0010111,
    15                                                   OP_FP     = 7'b1010011,   // FADD FSUB FMUL FDIV FSQRT
    16                                                   OP_FLOAD  = 7'b0000111,   // FLW
    17                                                   OP_FSTORE = 7'b0100111    // FSW
    18                                               } opcode_e;
    19                                               
    20                                               // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    21                                               // Base instruction item
    22                                               // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    23                                               class riscv_instr extends uvm_object;
    24                                                   `uvm_object_utils(riscv_instr)
    25                                               
    26                                                   rand logic [31:0] bits;          // Final encoded instruction word
    27                                                   rand opcode_e     opcode;
    28                                               
    29                                                   // Commonly used fields (set by child class encode())
    30                                                   rand logic [4:0]  rs1, rs2, rd;
    31                                                   rand logic [2:0]  funct3;
    32                                                   rand logic [6:0]  funct7;
    33                                                   rand logic [11:0] imm12;
    34                                                   rand logic [19:0] imm20;
    35                                               
    36                                                   // Prevent writes to x0
    37                                                   constraint c_no_x0_rd { rd != 5'h0; }
    38                                               
    39                                                   function new(string name = "riscv_instr");
    40                                                       super.new(name);
    41                                                   endfunction
    42                                               
    43                                                   // Override in child to pack fields into bits[]
    44                                                   virtual function void encode();
    45                                                       bits = 32'h00000013; // NOP by default
    46                                                   endfunction
    47                                               
    48                                                   virtual function string to_asm();
    49                                                       return $sformatf("instr=0x%08h", bits);
    50                                                   endfunction
    51                                               
    52                                               endclass
    53                                               
    54                                               
    55                                               class riscv_r_instr extends riscv_instr;
    56                                                   `uvm_object_utils(riscv_r_instr)
    57

    60                                                       SUB  = 10'b1_000,

    70

    86                                                   endfunction

    201                                              
    202                                                  function string to_asm();
    203                                                      return $sformatf("%-6s x%0d, %0d(x%0d)", func.name(), rs2, $signed(imm12), rs1);
    204                                                  endfunction
    205                                              
    206                                              endclass

    208                                              
    209                                              class riscv_branch_instr extends riscv_instr;
    210                                                  `uvm_object_utils(riscv_branch_instr)
    211                                              
    212                                                  typedef enum logic [2:0] {
    213                                                      BEQ  = 3'b000,
    214                                                      BNE  = 3'b001,
    215                                                      BLT  = 3'b100,
    216                                                      BGE  = 3'b101,
    217                                                      BLTU = 3'b110,
    218                                                      BGEU = 3'b111
    219                                                  } branch_func_e;
    220                                              
    221                                                  rand branch_func_e func;
    222                                                  rand logic signed [12:0] offset;  // signed, bits[12:1] go into B-imm, bit0=0
    223                                              
    224                                                  constraint c_opcode  { opcode == OP_BRANCH; }
    225                                                  constraint c_offset  { offset inside {[-64:64]}; offset[0] == 0; }
    226                                                  // No writes: override parent
    227                                                  constraint c_no_x0_rd { 1; }
    228                                              
    229                                                  function new(string name = "riscv_branch_instr");
    230                                                      super.new(name);
    231                                                  endfunction
    232                                              
    233                                                  function void encode();
    234                                                      logic [12:0] o;
    235                                                      funct3 = func;
    236                                                      o      = offset;
    237                                                      // B-type encoding: imm[12|10:5] | rs2 | rs1 | funct3 | imm[4:1|11] | opcode
    238                                                      bits   = {o[12], o[10:5], rs2, rs1, funct3, o[4:1], o[11], opcode};
    239                                                  endfunction
    240                                              
    241                                                  function string to_asm();
    242                                                      return $sformatf("%-6s x%0d, x%0d, %0d", func.name(), rs1, rs2, $signed(offset));
    243                                                  endfunction
    244                                              
    245                                              endclass

    272                                              class riscv_fp_instr extends riscv_instr;
    273                                                  `uvm_object_utils(riscv_fp_instr)
    274                                              
    275                                                  typedef enum logic [6:0] {
    276                                                      FADD  = 7'b0000000,
    277                                                      FSUB  = 7'b0000100,
    278                                                      FMUL  = 7'b0001000,
    279                                                      FDIV  = 7'b0001100,
    280                                                      FSQRT = 7'b0101100
    281                                                  } fp_func_e;
    282                                              
    283                                                  rand fp_func_e func;
    284                                              
    285                                                  constraint c_opcode  { opcode == OP_FP; }
    286                                                  // FSQRT only uses rs1
    287                                                  constraint c_fsqrt_rs2 { (func == FSQRT) -> (rs2 == 5'd0); }
    288                                              
    289                                                  function new(string name = "riscv_fp_instr");
    290                                                      super.new(name);
    291                                                  endfunction
    292                                              
    293                                                  function void encode();
    294                                                      funct7 = func;
    295                                                      funct3 = 3'b000;   // RNE rounding
    296                                                      bits   = {funct7, rs2, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode};
    297                                                  endfunction
    298                                              
    299                                                  function string to_asm();
    300                                                      if (func == FSQRT)
    301                                                          return $sformatf("FSQRT.S f%0d, f%0d", rd, rs1);
    302                                                      return $sformatf("%-8s f%0d, f%0d, f%0d", func.name(), rd, rs1, rs2);
    303                                                  endfunction
    304                                              
    305                                              endclass
    306                                              
    307                                              
    308                                              class riscv_fp_mem_instr extends riscv_instr;
    309                                                  `uvm_object_utils(riscv_fp_mem_instr)
    310                                              
    311                                                  rand bit is_store;
    312                                              
    313                                                  constraint c_opcode  { opcode == (is_store ? OP_FSTORE : OP_FLOAD); }
    314                                                  constraint c_imm_align { imm12[1:0] == 2'b00; imm12 < 12'd256; }
    315                                                  constraint c_no_x0_rd { 1; }   // FP dest register, not integer
    316                                              
    317                                                  function new(string name = "riscv_fp_mem_instr");
    318                                                      super.new(name);
    319                                                  endfunction
    320                                              
    321                                                  function void encode();
    322                                                      funct3 = 3'b010;  // .S (single precision)
    323                                                      if (is_store)
    324                                                          bits = {imm12[11:5], rs2, rs1, funct3, imm12[4:0], opcode};
    325                                                      else
    326                                                          bits = {imm12, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode};
    327                                                  endfunction
    328                                              
    329                                                  function string to_asm();
    330                                                      if (is_store)
    331                                                          return $sformatf("FSW    f%0d, %0d(x%0d)", rs2, $signed(imm12), rs1);
    332                                                      return $sformatf("FLW    f%0d, %0d(x%0d)", rd, $signed(imm12), rs1);
    333                                                  endfunction
    334                                              
    335                                              endclass
    5                                                typedef enum logic [6:0] {
    6                                                    OP_R      = 7'b0110011,   // ADD SUB AND OR XOR SLL SRL SRA SLT SLTU
    7                                                    OP_I_ALU  = 7'b0010011,   // ADDI ANDI ORI XORI SLTI SLTIU SLLI SRLI SRAI
    8                                                    OP_LOAD   = 7'b0000011,   // LB LH LW LBU LHU
    9                                                    OP_STORE  = 7'b0100011,   // SB SH SW
    10                                                   OP_BRANCH = 7'b1100011,   // BEQ BNE BLT BGE BLTU BGEU
    11                                                   OP_JAL    = 7'b1101111,
    12                                                   OP_JALR   = 7'b1100111,
    13                                                   OP_LUI    = 7'b0110111,
    14                                                   OP_AUIPC  = 7'b0010111,
    15                                                   OP_FP     = 7'b1010011,   // FADD FSUB FMUL FDIV FSQRT
    16                                                   OP_FLOAD  = 7'b0000111,   // FLW
    17                                                   OP_FSTORE = 7'b0100111    // FSW
    18                                               } opcode_e;
    19                                               
    20                                               // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    21                                               // Base instruction item
    22                                               // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    23                                               class riscv_instr extends uvm_object;
    24                                                   `uvm_object_utils(riscv_instr)
    25                                               
    26                                                   rand logic [31:0] bits;          // Final encoded instruction word
    27                                                   rand opcode_e     opcode;
    28                                               
    29                                                   // Commonly used fields (set by child class encode())
    30                                                   rand logic [4:0]  rs1, rs2, rd;
    31                                                   rand logic [2:0]  funct3;
    32                                                   rand logic [6:0]  funct7;
    33                                                   rand logic [11:0] imm12;
    34                                                   rand logic [19:0] imm20;
    35                                               
    36                                                   // Prevent writes to x0
    37                                                   constraint c_no_x0_rd { rd != 5'h0; }
    38                                               
    39                                                   function new(string name = "riscv_instr");
    40                                                       super.new(name);
    41                                                   endfunction
    42                                               
    43                                                   // Override in child to pack fields into bits[]
    44                                                   virtual function void encode();
    45                                                       bits = 32'h00000013; // NOP by default
    46                                                   endfunction
    47                                               
    48                                                   virtual function string to_asm();
    49                                                       return $sformatf("instr=0x%08h", bits);
    50                                                   endfunction
    51                                               
    52                                               endclass
    53                                               
    54                                               
    55                                               class riscv_r_instr extends riscv_instr;
    56                                                   `uvm_object_utils(riscv_r_instr)
    57                                               
    58                                                   typedef enum logic [9:0] {   // {funct7[5], funct3}
    59                                                       ADD  = 10'b0_000,
    60                                                       SUB  = 10'b1_000,
    61                                                       SLL  = 10'b0_001,
    62                                                       SLT  = 10'b0_010,
    63                                                       SLTU = 10'b0_011,
    64                                                       XOR  = 10'b0_100,
    65                                                       SRL  = 10'b0_101,
    66                                                       SRA  = 10'b1_101,
    67                                                       OR   = 10'b0_110,
    68                                                       AND  = 10'b0_111
    69                                                   } r_func_e;
    70                                               
    71                                                   rand r_func_e func;
    72                                               
    73                                                   constraint c_opcode { opcode == OP_R; }
    74                                               
    75                                                   function new(string name = "riscv_r_instr");
    76                                                       super.new(name);
    77                                                   endfunction
    78                                               
    79                                                   function void encode();
    80                                                       logic f7_5;
    81                                                       logic [2:0] f3;
    82                                                       {f7_5, f3} = func;
    83                                                       funct7 = {1'b0, f7_5, 5'b0};  // bit5 is the discriminating bit (SUB/SRA=0x20, others=0x00)
    84                                                       funct3 = f3;
    85                                                       bits   = {funct7, rs2, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode};
    86                                                   endfunction
    87                                               
    88                                                   function string to_asm();
    89                                                       return $sformatf("%-6s x%0d, x%0d, x%0d",
    90                                                                        func.name(), rd, rs1, rs2);
    91                                                   endfunction
    92                                               
    93                                               endclass
    94                                               
    95                                               
    96                                               class riscv_i_alu_instr extends riscv_instr;
    97                                                   `uvm_object_utils(riscv_i_alu_instr)
    98                                               
    99                                                   typedef enum logic [3:0] {
    100                                                      ADDI  = 4'd0,
    101                                                      SLTI  = 4'd1,
    102                                                      SLTIU = 4'd2,
    103                                                      XORI  = 4'd3,
    104                                                      ORI   = 4'd4,
    105                                                      ANDI  = 4'd5,
    106                                                      SLLI  = 4'd6,
    107                                                      SRLI  = 4'd7,
    108                                                      SRAI  = 4'd8
    109                                                  } i_func_e;
    110                                              
    111                                                  rand i_func_e func;
    112                                                  rand logic [4:0] shamt;   // shift amount for shift instructions
    113                                              
    114                                                  constraint c_opcode { opcode == OP_I_ALU; }
    115                                                  constraint c_shamt  { shamt < 32; }
    116                                              
    117                                                  // Keep immediates in a small sensible range to avoid extreme values
    118                                                  constraint c_imm    { imm12 inside {[0:255]}; }
    119                                              
    120                                                  function new(string name = "riscv_i_alu_instr");
    121                                                      super.new(name);
    122                                                  endfunction
    123                                              
    124                                                  function void encode();
    125                                                      case (func)
    126                                                          ADDI:  begin funct3 = 3'b000; bits = {imm12, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode}; end
    127                                                          SLTI:  begin funct3 = 3'b010; bits = {imm12, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode}; end
    128                                                          SLTIU: begin funct3 = 3'b011; bits = {imm12, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode}; end
    129                                                          XORI:  begin funct3 = 3'b100; bits = {imm12, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode}; end
    130                                                          ORI:   begin funct3 = 3'b110; bits = {imm12, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode}; end
    131                                                          ANDI:  begin funct3 = 3'b111; bits = {imm12, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode}; end
    132                                                          SLLI:  begin funct3 = 3'b001; bits = {7'b0000000, shamt, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode}; end
    133                                                          SRLI:  begin funct3 = 3'b101; bits = {7'b0000000, shamt, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode}; end
    134                                                          SRAI:  begin funct3 = 3'b101; bits = {7'b0100000, shamt, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode}; end
    135                                                      endcase
    136                                                  endfunction
    137                                              
    138                                                  function string to_asm();
    139                                                      if (func inside {SLLI, SRLI, SRAI})
    140                                                          return $sformatf("%-6s x%0d, x%0d, %0d", func.name(), rd, rs1, shamt);
    141                                                      return $sformatf("%-6s x%0d, x%0d, %0d", func.name(), rd, rs1, $signed(imm12));
    142                                                  endfunction
    143                                              
    144                                              endclass
    145                                              
    146

    12                                                   OP_JALR   = 7'b1100111,
    13                                                   OP_LUI    = 7'b0110111,
    14                                                   OP_AUIPC  = 7'b0010111,
    15                                                   OP_FP     = 7'b1010011,   // FADD FSUB FMUL FDIV FSQRT
    16                                                   OP_FLOAD  = 7'b0000111,   // FLW
    17                                                   OP_FSTORE = 7'b0100111    // FSW
    18                                               } opcode_e;
    19                                               
    20                                               // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    21                                               // Base instruction item
    22                                               // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    23                                               class riscv_instr extends uvm_object;
    24                                                   `uvm_object_utils(riscv_instr)
    25                                               
    26                                                   rand logic [31:0] bits;          // Final encoded instruction word
    27                                                   rand opcode_e     opcode;
    28                                               
    29                                                   // Commonly used fields (set by child class encode())
    30                                                   rand logic [4:0]  rs1, rs2, rd;
    31                                                   rand logic [2:0]  funct3;
    32                                                   rand logic [6:0]  funct7;
    33                                                   rand logic [11:0] imm12;
    34                                                   rand logic [19:0] imm20;
    35                                               
    36                                                   // Prevent writes to x0
    37                                                   constraint c_no_x0_rd { rd != 5'h0; }
    38                                               
    39                                                   function new(string name = "riscv_instr");
    40                                                       super.new(name);
    41                                                   endfunction
    42                                               
    43                                                   // Override in child to pack fields into bits[]
    44                                                   virtual function void encode();
    45                                                       bits = 32'h00000013; // NOP by default
    46                                                   endfunction
    47                                               
    48                                                   virtual function string to_asm();
    49                                                       return $sformatf("instr=0x%08h", bits);
    50                                                   endfunction
    51                                               
    52                                               endclass
    53                                               
    54                                               
    55                                               class riscv_r_instr extends riscv_instr;
    56                                                   `uvm_object_utils(riscv_r_instr)
    57                                               
    58                                                   typedef enum logic [9:0] {   // {funct7[5], funct3}
    59                                                       ADD  = 10'b0_000,
    60                                                       SUB  = 10'b1_000,
    61                                                       SLL  = 10'b0_001,
    62                                                       SLT  = 10'b0_010,
    63                                                       SLTU = 10'b0_011,
    64                                                       XOR  = 10'b0_100,
    65                                                       SRL  = 10'b0_101,
    66                                                       SRA  = 10'b1_101,
    67                                                       OR   = 10'b0_110,
    68                                                       AND  = 10'b0_111
    69                                                   } r_func_e;
    70                                               
    71                                                   rand r_func_e func;
    72                                               
    73                                                   constraint c_opcode { opcode == OP_R; }
    74                                               
    75                                                   function new(string name = "riscv_r_instr");
    76                                                       super.new(name);
    77                                                   endfunction
    78                                               
    79                                                   function void encode();
    80                                                       logic f7_5;
    81                                                       logic [2:0] f3;
    82                                                       {f7_5, f3} = func;
    83                                                       funct7 = {1'b0, f7_5, 5'b0};  // bit5 is the discriminating bit (SUB/SRA=0x20, others=0x00)
    84                                                       funct3 = f3;
    85                                                       bits   = {funct7, rs2, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode};
    86                                                   endfunction
    87                                               
    88                                                   function string to_asm();
    89                                                       return $sformatf("%-6s x%0d, x%0d, x%0d",
    90                                                                        func.name(), rd, rs1, rs2);
    91                                                   endfunction
    92                                               
    93                                               endclass
    94                                               
    95                                               
    96                                               class riscv_i_alu_instr extends riscv_instr;
    97                                                   `uvm_object_utils(riscv_i_alu_instr)
    98                                               
    99                                                   typedef enum logic [3:0] {
    100                                                      ADDI  = 4'd0,
    101                                                      SLTI  = 4'd1,
    102                                                      SLTIU = 4'd2,
    103                                                      XORI  = 4'd3,
    104                                                      ORI   = 4'd4,
    105                                                      ANDI  = 4'd5,
    106                                                      SLLI  = 4'd6,
    107                                                      SRLI  = 4'd7,
    108                                                      SRAI  = 4'd8
    109                                                  } i_func_e;
    110                                              
    111                                                  rand i_func_e func;
    112                                                  rand logic [4:0] shamt;   // shift amount for shift instructions
    113                                              
    114                                                  constraint c_opcode { opcode == OP_I_ALU; }
    115                                                  constraint c_shamt  { shamt < 32; }
    116                                              
    117                                                  // Keep immediates in a small sensible range to avoid extreme values
    118                                                  constraint c_imm    { imm12 inside {[0:255]}; }
    119                                              
    120                                                  function new(string name = "riscv_i_alu_instr");
    121                                                      super.new(name);
    122                                                  endfunction
    123                                              
    124                                                  function void encode();
    125                                                      case (func)
    126                                                          ADDI:  begin funct3 = 3'b000; bits = {imm12, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode}; end
    127                                                          SLTI:  begin funct3 = 3'b010; bits = {imm12, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode}; end
    128                                                          SLTIU: begin funct3 = 3'b011; bits = {imm12, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode}; end
    129                                                          XORI:  begin funct3 = 3'b100; bits = {imm12, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode}; end
    130                                                          ORI:   begin funct3 = 3'b110; bits = {imm12, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode}; end
    131                                                          ANDI:  begin funct3 = 3'b111; bits = {imm12, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode}; end
    132                                                          SLLI:  begin funct3 = 3'b001; bits = {7'b0000000, shamt, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode}; end
    133                                                          SRLI:  begin funct3 = 3'b101; bits = {7'b0000000, shamt, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode}; end
    134                                                          SRAI:  begin funct3 = 3'b101; bits = {7'b0100000, shamt, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode}; end
    135                                                      endcase
    136                                                  endfunction
    137                                              
    138                                                  function string to_asm();
    139                                                      if (func inside {SLLI, SRLI, SRAI})
    140                                                          return $sformatf("%-6s x%0d, x%0d, %0d", func.name(), rd, rs1, shamt);
    141                                                      return $sformatf("%-6s x%0d, x%0d, %0d", func.name(), rd, rs1, $signed(imm12));
    142                                                  endfunction
    143                                              
    144                                              endclass
    145

    147                                              class riscv_load_instr extends riscv_instr;
    148                                                  `uvm_object_utils(riscv_load_instr)
    149                                              
    150                                                  typedef enum logic [2:0] {
    151                                                      LW  = 3'b010
    152                                                  } load_func_e;
    153                                              
    154                                                  rand load_func_e func;
    155                                              
    156                                                  constraint c_opcode { opcode == OP_LOAD; }
    157                                                  // Offset within first 256 bytes of data memory (word-aligned for LW)
    158                                                  constraint c_imm_lw { (func == LW)  -> (imm12[1:0] == 2'b00 && imm12 < 12'd256); }
    159                                                  constraint c_imm    { imm12 < 12'd256; }
    160                                              
    161                                                  function new(string name = "riscv_load_instr");
    162                                                      super.new(name);
    163                                                  endfunction
    164                                              
    165                                                  function void encode();
    166                                                      funct3 = func;
    167                                                      bits   = {imm12, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode};
    168                                                  endfunction
    169                                              
    170                                                  function string to_asm();
    171                                                      return $sformatf("%-6s x%0d, %0d(x%0d)", func.name(), rd, $signed(imm12), rs1);
    172                                                  endfunction
    173                                              
    174                                              endclass

    177                                              class riscv_store_instr extends riscv_instr;

    185

    188                                                  constraint c_imm     { imm12 < 12'd256; }

    194                                                      super.new(name);

    199                                                      bits   = {imm12[11:5], rs2, rs1, funct3, imm12[4:0], opcode};
    200                                                  endfunction
    201                                              
    202                                                  function string to_asm();
    203                                                      return $sformatf("%-6s x%0d, %0d(x%0d)", func.name(), rs2, $signed(imm12), rs1);
    204                                                  endfunction

    209                                              class riscv_branch_instr extends riscv_instr;
    210                                                  `uvm_object_utils(riscv_branch_instr)
    211                                              
    212                                                  typedef enum logic [2:0] {
    213                                                      BEQ  = 3'b000,
    214                                                      BNE  = 3'b001,
    215                                                      BLT  = 3'b100,
    216                                                      BGE  = 3'b101,
    217                                                      BLTU = 3'b110,
    218                                                      BGEU = 3'b111
    219                                                  } branch_func_e;
    220                                              
    221                                                  rand branch_func_e func;
    222                                                  rand logic signed [12:0] offset;  // signed, bits[12:1] go into B-imm, bit0=0
    223                                              
    224                                                  constraint c_opcode  { opcode == OP_BRANCH; }
    225                                                  constraint c_offset  { offset inside {[-64:64]}; offset[0] == 0; }
    226                                                  // No writes: override parent
    227                                                  constraint c_no_x0_rd { 1; }
    228                                              
    229                                                  function new(string name = "riscv_branch_instr");
    230                                                      super.new(name);
    231                                                  endfunction
    232                                              
    233                                                  function void encode();
    234                                                      logic [12:0] o;
    235                                                      funct3 = func;
    236                                                      o      = offset;
    237                                                      // B-type encoding: imm[12|10:5] | rs2 | rs1 | funct3 | imm[4:1|11] | opcode
    238                                                      bits   = {o[12], o[10:5], rs2, rs1, funct3, o[4:1], o[11], opcode};
    239                                                  endfunction
    240                                              
    241                                                  function string to_asm();
    242                                                      return $sformatf("%-6s x%0d, x%0d, %0d", func.name(), rs1, rs2, $signed(offset));
    243                                                  endfunction
    244                                              
    245                                              endclass
    246                                              
    247                                              
    248                                              class riscv_u_instr extends riscv_instr;
    249                                                  `uvm_object_utils(riscv_u_instr)
    250                                              
    251                                                  rand bit is_auipc;
    252                                              
    253                                                  constraint c_imm20 { imm20 != 0; }
    254                                              
    255                                                  function new(string name = "riscv_u_instr");
    256                                                      super.new(name);
    257                                                  endfunction
    258                                              
    259                                                  function void encode();
    260                                                      opcode = is_auipc ? OP_AUIPC : OP_LUI;
    261                                                      bits   = {imm20, rd, opcode};
    262                                                  endfunction
    263                                              
    264                                                  function string to_asm();
    265                                                      return $sformatf("%-6s x%0d, 0x%05h",
    266                                                                       is_auipc ? "AUIPC" : "LUI", rd, imm20);
    267                                                  endfunction
    268                                              
    269                                              endclass

    271                                              
    272                                              class riscv_fp_instr extends riscv_instr;
    273                                                  `uvm_object_utils(riscv_fp_instr)
    274                                              
    275                                                  typedef enum logic [6:0] {
    276                                                      FADD  = 7'b0000000,
    277                                                      FSUB  = 7'b0000100,
    278                                                      FMUL  = 7'b0001000,
    279                                                      FDIV  = 7'b0001100,
    280                                                      FSQRT = 7'b0101100
    281                                                  } fp_func_e;
    282                                              
    283                                                  rand fp_func_e func;
    284                                              
    285                                                  constraint c_opcode  { opcode == OP_FP; }
    286                                                  // FSQRT only uses rs1
    287                                                  constraint c_fsqrt_rs2 { (func == FSQRT) -> (rs2 == 5'd0); }
    288                                              
    289                                                  function new(string name = "riscv_fp_instr");
    290                                                      super.new(name);
    291                                                  endfunction
    292                                              
    293                                                  function void encode();
    294                                                      funct7 = func;
    295                                                      funct3 = 3'b000;   // RNE rounding
    296                                                      bits   = {funct7, rs2, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode};
    297                                                  endfunction
    298                                              
    299                                                  function string to_asm();
    300                                                      if (func == FSQRT)
    301                                                          return $sformatf("FSQRT.S f%0d, f%0d", rd, rs1);
    302                                                      return $sformatf("%-8s f%0d, f%0d, f%0d", func.name(), rd, rs1, rs2);
    303                                                  endfunction
    304                                              
    305                                              endclass
    306                                              
    307                                              
    308                                              class riscv_fp_mem_instr extends riscv_instr;
    309                                                  `uvm_object_utils(riscv_fp_mem_instr)
    310                                              
    311                                                  rand bit is_store;
    312                                              
    313                                                  constraint c_opcode  { opcode == (is_store ? OP_FSTORE : OP_FLOAD); }
    314                                                  constraint c_imm_align { imm12[1:0] == 2'b00; imm12 < 12'd256; }
    315                                                  constraint c_no_x0_rd { 1; }   // FP dest register, not integer
    316                                              
    317                                                  function new(string name = "riscv_fp_mem_instr");
    318                                                      super.new(name);
    319                                                  endfunction
    320                                              
    321                                                  function void encode();
    322                                                      funct3 = 3'b010;  // .S (single precision)
    323                                                      if (is_store)
    324                                                          bits = {imm12[11:5], rs2, rs1, funct3, imm12[4:0], opcode};
    325                                                      else
    326                                                          bits = {imm12, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode};
    327                                                  endfunction
    328                                              
    329                                                  function string to_asm();
    330                                                      if (is_store)
    331                                                          return $sformatf("FSW    f%0d, %0d(x%0d)", rs2, $signed(imm12), rs1);
    332                                                      return $sformatf("FLW    f%0d, %0d(x%0d)", rd, $signed(imm12), rs1);
    333                                                  endfunction
    334                                              
    335                                              endclass
    5                                                typedef enum logic [6:0] {
    6                                                    OP_R      = 7'b0110011,   // ADD SUB AND OR XOR SLL SRL SRA SLT SLTU

    150                                                  typedef enum logic [2:0] {
    151                                                      LW  = 3'b010
    152                                                  } load_func_e;
    153                                              
    154                                                  rand load_func_e func;
    155                                              
    156                                                  constraint c_opcode { opcode == OP_LOAD; }
    157                                                  // Offset within first 256 bytes of data memory (word-aligned for LW)
    158                                                  constraint c_imm_lw { (func == LW)  -> (imm12[1:0] == 2'b00 && imm12 < 12'd256); }
    159                                                  constraint c_imm    { imm12 < 12'd256; }
    160                                              
    161                                                  function new(string name = "riscv_load_instr");
    162                                                      super.new(name);
    163                                                  endfunction
    164                                              
    165                                                  function void encode();
    166                                                      funct3 = func;
    167                                                      bits   = {imm12, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode};
    168                                                  endfunction
    169                                              
    170                                                  function string to_asm();
    171                                                      return $sformatf("%-6s x%0d, %0d(x%0d)", func.name(), rd, $signed(imm12), rs1);
    172                                                  endfunction
    173                                              
    174                                              endclass

    200                                                  endfunction
    201                                              
    202                                                  function string to_asm();

    209                                              class riscv_branch_instr extends riscv_instr;
    210                                                  `uvm_object_utils(riscv_branch_instr)
    211                                              
    212                                                  typedef enum logic [2:0] {
    213                                                      BEQ  = 3'b000,
    214                                                      BNE  = 3'b001,
    215                                                      BLT  = 3'b100,
    216                                                      BGE  = 3'b101,
    217                                                      BLTU = 3'b110,
    218                                                      BGEU = 3'b111
    219                                                  } branch_func_e;
    220                                              
    221                                                  rand branch_func_e func;
    222                                                  rand logic signed [12:0] offset;  // signed, bits[12:1] go into B-imm, bit0=0
    223                                              
    224                                                  constraint c_opcode  { opcode == OP_BRANCH; }
    225                                                  constraint c_offset  { offset inside {[-64:64]}; offset[0] == 0; }
    226                                                  // No writes: override parent
    227                                                  constraint c_no_x0_rd { 1; }
    228                                              
    229                                                  function new(string name = "riscv_branch_instr");
    230                                                      super.new(name);
    231                                                  endfunction
    232                                              
    233                                                  function void encode();
    234                                                      logic [12:0] o;
    235                                                      funct3 = func;
    236                                                      o      = offset;
    237                                                      // B-type encoding: imm[12|10:5] | rs2 | rs1 | funct3 | imm[4:1|11] | opcode
    238                                                      bits   = {o[12], o[10:5], rs2, rs1, funct3, o[4:1], o[11], opcode};
    239                                                  endfunction
    240                                              
    241                                                  function string to_asm();
    242                                                      return $sformatf("%-6s x%0d, x%0d, %0d", func.name(), rs1, rs2, $signed(offset));
    243                                                  endfunction
    244                                              
    245                                              endclass

    265                                                      return $sformatf("%-6s x%0d, 0x%05h",

    267                                                  endfunction
