    96                                               class riscv_i_alu_instr extends riscv_instr;
    97                                                   `uvm_object_utils(riscv_i_alu_instr)
    98                                               
    99                                                   typedef enum logic [3:0] {
    100                                                      ADDI  = 4'd0,
    101                                                      SLTI  = 4'd1,
    102                                                      SLTIU = 4'd2,
    103                                                      XORI  = 4'd3,
    104                                                      ORI   = 4'd4,
    105                                                      ANDI  = 4'd5,
    106                                                      SLLI  = 4'd6,
    107                                                      SRLI  = 4'd7,
    108                                                      SRAI  = 4'd8
    109                                                  } i_func_e;
    110                                              
    111                                                  rand i_func_e func;
    112                                                  rand logic [4:0] shamt;   // shift amount for shift instructions
    113                                              
    114                                                  constraint c_opcode { opcode == OP_I_ALU; }
    115                                                  constraint c_shamt  { shamt < 32; }
    116                                              
    117                                                  // Keep immediates in a small sensible range to avoid extreme values
    118                                                  constraint c_imm    { imm12 inside {[0:255]}; }
    119                                              
    120                                                  function new(string name = "riscv_i_alu_instr");
    121                                                      super.new(name);
    122                                                  endfunction
    123                                              
    124                                                  function void encode();
    125                                                      case (func)
    126                                                          ADDI:  begin funct3 = 3'b000; bits = {imm12, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode}; end
    127                                                          SLTI:  begin funct3 = 3'b010; bits = {imm12, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode}; end
    128                                                          SLTIU: begin funct3 = 3'b011; bits = {imm12, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode}; end
    129                                                          XORI:  begin funct3 = 3'b100; bits = {imm12, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode}; end
    130                                                          ORI:   begin funct3 = 3'b110; bits = {imm12, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode}; end
    131                                                          ANDI:  begin funct3 = 3'b111; bits = {imm12, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode}; end
    132                                                          SLLI:  begin funct3 = 3'b001; bits = {7'b0000000, shamt, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode}; end
    133                                                          SRLI:  begin funct3 = 3'b101; bits = {7'b0000000, shamt, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode}; end
    134                                                          SRAI:  begin funct3 = 3'b101; bits = {7'b0100000, shamt, rs1, funct3, rd, opcode}; end
    135                                                      endcase
    136                                                  endfunction
    137                                              
    138                                                  function string to_asm();
    139                                                      if (func inside {SLLI, SRLI, SRAI})
    140                                                          return $sformatf("%-6s x%0d, x%0d, %0d", func.name(), rd, rs1, shamt);
    141                                                      return $sformatf("%-6s x%0d, x%0d, %0d", func.name(), rd, rs1, $signed(imm12));
    142                                                  endfunction
    143                                              
    144                                              endclass

    239                                                  endfunction

    242                                                      return $sformatf("%-6s x%0d, x%0d, %0d", func.name(), rs1, rs2, $signed(offset));

    68                                                   uvm_analysis_port #(mem_txn)            ap_mem;
    69                                                   uvm_analysis_port #(branch_txn)         ap_branch;
    70                                                   uvm_analysis_port #(pipeline_stats_txn) ap_stats;
    71                                               
    72                                                   // Internal counters
    73                                                   int unsigned total_cycles;
    74                                                   int unsigned instr_retired;
    75                                                   int unsigned stall_cycles;
    76                                                   int unsigned branch_count;
    77                                                   int unsigned mispredicts;
    78                                                   int unsigned cache_misses;

    80                                                   function new(string name, uvm_component parent);
    81                                                       super.new(name, parent);
    82                                                   endfunction
    83                                               
    84                                                   // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    85                                                   function void build_phase(uvm_phase phase);
    86                                                       super.build_phase(phase);
    87                                               
    88                                                       // Read config object — get vif and all monitoring knobs from it
    89                                                       if (!uvm_config_db #(riscv_env_config)::get(this, "", "cfg", cfg))
    90                                                           `uvm_fatal("NOCFG", "riscv_monitor: riscv_env_config not found")
    91                                               
    92                                                       vif = cfg.vif;
    93                                                       if (vif == null)
    94                                                           `uvm_fatal("NOVIF", "riscv_monitor: cfg.vif is null")
    95                                               
    96                                                       ap_reg_write = new("ap_reg_write", this);
    97                                                       ap_mem       = new("ap_mem",       this);
    98                                                       ap_branch    = new("ap_branch",    this);
    99                                                       ap_stats     = new("ap_stats",     this);
    100                                                  endfunction
    101                                              
    102                                                  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    103                                                  task run_phase(uvm_phase phase);
    104                                                      reset_counters();
    105                                                      fork
    106                                                          monitor_reg_writes();
    107                                                          monitor_mem_ops();
    108                                                          monitor_branches();
    109                                                          monitor_stalls();
    110                                                          monitor_cache();
    111                                                      join
    112                                                  endtask
    113                                              
    114                                                  task reset_counters();
    115                                                      total_cycles  = 0; instr_retired = 0;
    116                                                      stall_cycles  = 0; branch_count  = 0;
    117                                                      mispredicts   = 0; cache_misses  = 0;
    118                                                  endtask
    119                                              
    120                                                  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    121                                                  task monitor_reg_writes();
    122                                                      forever begin
    123                                                          @(vif.mon_cb);
    124                                                          if (!vif.mon_cb.rst_n) continue;
    125                                                          if(vif.InstrDM==32'h0000006F)
    126                                                              en=1;
    127                                                          
    128                                                          if (en!=1'd1)
    129                                                              total_cycles++;
    130                                              
    131                                                          if (vif.mon_cb.RegWriteW && vif.mon_cb.RDW != 5'h0) begin
    132                                                              reg_write_txn t = reg_write_txn::type_id::create("rwt");
    133                                                              t.rd = vif.mon_cb.RDW; t.data = vif.mon_cb.ResultW; t.is_fp = 0;
    134                                                              ap_reg_write.write(t);
    135                                                              if (cfg.log_every_reg_write)
    136                                                                  `uvm_info("MON", t.convert2string(), UVM_LOW)
    137                                                          end
    138                                              
    139                                                          if (vif.mon_cb.FRegWriteMW) begin
    140                                                              reg_write_txn t = reg_write_txn::type_id::create("frwt");
    141                                                              t.rd   = vif.mon_cb.RDW;
    142                                                              t.data = vif.mon_cb.FResultW;
    143                                                              t.is_fp = 1;
    144                                                              ap_reg_write.write(t);
    145                                                          end
    146                                              
    147                                                          if (vif.mon_cb.InstrD != 32'h00000013 &&
    148                                                              vif.mon_cb.InstrD != 32'h0          &&
    149                                                              vif.mon_cb.InstrD != 32'h0000006F   &&
    150                                                              !vif.mon_cb.StallD)
    151                                                              instr_retired++;
    152                                                      end
    153                                                  endtask
    154                                              
    155                                                  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    156                                                  task monitor_mem_ops();
    157                                                      forever begin
    158                                                          @(vif.mon_cb);
    159                                                          if (!vif.mon_cb.rst_n) continue;
    160                                                          if (vif.mon_cb.MemWriteM) begin
    161                                                              mem_txn t = mem_txn::type_id::create("mt");
    162                                                              t.addr = vif.mon_cb.ALU_ResultM;
    163                                                              t.data = vif.mon_cb.WriteDataM;
    164                                                              t.is_write = 1;
    165                                                              ap_mem.write(t);
    166                                                              if (cfg.log_every_mem_write)
    167                                                                  `uvm_info("MON", t.convert2string(), UVM_LOW)
    168                                                          end
    169                                                      end
    170                                                  endtask
    171                                              
    172                                                  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    173                                                  task monitor_branches();
    174                                                      forever begin
    175                                                          @(vif.mon_cb);
    176                                                          if (!vif.mon_cb.rst_n) continue;
    177                                                          if (vif.mon_cb.BranchE) begin
    178                                                              branch_txn t = branch_txn::type_id::create("bt");
    179                                                              t.pc           = vif.mon_cb.PCD;
    180                                                              t.target       = vif.mon_cb.PCTargetE;
    181                                                              t.taken        = vif.mon_cb.PCSrcE;
    182                                                              t.mispredicted = vif.mon_cb.mispredict;
    183                                                              ap_branch.write(t);
    184                                                              branch_count++;
    185                                                              if (vif.mispredict) begin
    186                                                                  mispredicts++;
    187                                                                  if (cfg.track_mispredicts)
    188                                                                      `uvm_info("MON", $sformatf("MISPREDICT: %s", t.convert2string()), UVM_MEDIUM)
    189                                                              end
    190                                                          end
    191                                                      end
    192                                                  endtask
    193                                              
    194                                                  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    195                                                  task monitor_stalls();
    196                                                      forever begin
    197                                                          @(vif.mon_cb);
    198                                                          if (!vif.mon_cb.rst_n) continue;
    199                                                          if ($isunknown(vif.mon_cb.InstrD)) continue;  // past program end
    200                                                          if (vif.mon_cb.StallF || vif.mon_cb.StallD || vif.mon_cb.stall)
    201                                                              stall_cycles++;
    202                                                      end
    203                                                  endtask
    204                                              
    205                                                  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    206                                                  task monitor_cache();
    207                                                      logic [2:0] prev_state = 0;
    208                                                      forever begin
    209                                                          @(vif.mon_cb);
    210                                                          if (!vif.mon_cb.rst_n) begin prev_state = 0; continue; end
    211                                                          if (prev_state != 3'd3 && vif.mon_cb.cache_state == 3'd3) begin
    212                                                              cache_misses++;
    213                                                              if (cfg.detailed_cache_stats)
    214                                                                  `uvm_info("MON",
    215                                                                      $sformatf("CACHE MISS #%0d", cache_misses), UVM_LOW)
    216                                                          end
    217                                                          prev_state = vif.mon_cb.cache_state;
    218                                                      end
    219                                                  endtask
    220                                              
    221                                                  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    222                                                  function void publish_stats();
    223                                                      pipeline_stats_txn s = pipeline_stats_txn::type_id::create("stats");
    224                                                      s.total_cycles  = total_cycles;
    225                                                      s.instr_retired = instr_retired;
    226                                                      s.stall_cycles  = stall_cycles;
    227                                                      s.branch_count  = branch_count;
    228                                                      s.mispredicts   = mispredicts;
    229                                                      s.cache_misses  = cache_misses;
    230                                                      s.ipc = (total_cycles > 0) ?
    231                                                                  real'(instr_retired) / real'(total_cycles) : 0.0;
    232                                                      ap_stats.write(s);
    233                                                      `uvm_info("MON", s.convert2string(), UVM_LOW)
    234                                                  endfunction
    235                                              
    236                                                 task reset_for_new_program();
    237                                                  en = 0;
    238                                              endtask
    239                                              endclass : riscv_monitor
    5                                                class reg_write_txn extends uvm_sequence_item;
    6                                                    `uvm_object_utils(reg_write_txn)
    7                                                    logic [4:0]  rd;
    8                                                    logic [31:0] data;
    9                                                    logic [31:0] pc;
    10                                                   bit          is_fp;
    11                                                   function new(string name="reg_write_txn"); super.new(name); endfunction
    12                                                   function string convert2string();
    13                                                       return $sformatf("%s[%0d]=0x%08h @ PC=0x%08h", is_fp?"f":"x", rd, data, pc);
    14                                                   endfunction
    15                                               endclass
    16                                               
    17                                               class mem_txn extends uvm_sequence_item;
    18                                                   `uvm_object_utils(mem_txn)
    19                                                   logic [31:0] addr;
    20                                                   logic [31:0] data;
    21                                                   bit          is_write;
    22                                                   function new(string name="mem_txn"); super.new(name); endfunction
    23                                                   function string convert2string();
    24                                                       return $sformatf("MEM_%s addr=0x%08h data=0x%08h",
    25                                                                        is_write?"WR":"RD", addr, data);
    26                                                   endfunction
    27                                               endclass
    28                                               
    29                                               class branch_txn extends uvm_sequence_item;
    30                                                   `uvm_object_utils(branch_txn)
    31                                                   logic [31:0] pc;
    32                                                   logic [31:0] target;
    33                                                   bit          taken;
    34                                                   bit          mispredicted;
    35                                                   function new(string name="branch_txn"); super.new(name); endfunction
    36                                                   function string convert2string();
    37                                                       return $sformatf("BRANCH @ 0x%08h %s target=0x%08h mispredict=%0b",
    38                                                                        pc, taken?"TAKEN":"NOT_TAKEN", target, mispredicted);
    39                                                   endfunction
    40                                               endclass
    41                                               
    42                                               class pipeline_stats_txn extends uvm_sequence_item;
    43                                                   `uvm_object_utils(pipeline_stats_txn)
    44                                                   int unsigned total_cycles;
    45                                                   int unsigned instr_retired;
    46                                                   int unsigned stall_cycles;
    47                                                   int unsigned branch_count;
    48                                                   int unsigned mispredicts;
    49                                                   int unsigned cache_misses;
    50                                                   real         ipc;
    51                                                   function new(string name="pipeline_stats_txn"); super.new(name); endfunction
    52                                                   function string convert2string();
    53                                                       return $sformatf(
    54                                                           "STATS: cycles=%0d retired=%0d stalls=%0d IPC=%.3f branches=%0d mispredict=%0d cache_miss=%0d",
    55                                                           total_cycles, instr_retired, stall_cycles, ipc,
    56                                                           branch_count, mispredicts, cache_misses);
    57                                                   endfunction
    58                                               endclass
    59                                               
    60                                               // ===========================================================================
    61                                               class riscv_monitor extends uvm_monitor;
    62                                                   `uvm_component_utils(riscv_monitor)
    63                                               
    64                                                   virtual riscv_if  vif;
    65                                                   riscv_env_config  cfg;
    66                                               
    67                                                   uvm_analysis_port #(reg_write_txn)      ap_reg_write;
    68                                                   uvm_analysis_port #(mem_txn)            ap_mem;
    69                                                   uvm_analysis_port #(branch_txn)         ap_branch;
    70                                                   uvm_analysis_port #(pipeline_stats_txn) ap_stats;
    71                                               
    72                                                   // Internal counters
    73                                                   int unsigned total_cycles;
    74                                                   int unsigned instr_retired;
    75                                                   int unsigned stall_cycles;
    76                                                   int unsigned branch_count;
    77                                                   int unsigned mispredicts;
    78                                                   int unsigned cache_misses;
    79                                                   bit en;
    80                                                   function new(string name, uvm_component parent);
    81                                                       super.new(name, parent);
    82                                                   endfunction
    83                                               
    84                                                   // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    85                                                   function void build_phase(uvm_phase phase);
    86                                                       super.build_phase(phase);
    87                                               
    88                                                       // Read config object — get vif and all monitoring knobs from it
    89                                                       if (!uvm_config_db #(riscv_env_config)::get(this, "", "cfg", cfg))
    90                                                           `uvm_fatal("NOCFG", "riscv_monitor: riscv_env_config not found")
    91                                               
    92                                                       vif = cfg.vif;
    93                                                       if (vif == null)
    94                                                           `uvm_fatal("NOVIF", "riscv_monitor: cfg.vif is null")
    95                                               
    96                                                       ap_reg_write = new("ap_reg_write", this);
    97                                                       ap_mem       = new("ap_mem",       this);
    98                                                       ap_branch    = new("ap_branch",    this);
    99                                                       ap_stats     = new("ap_stats",     this);
    100                                                  endfunction
    101                                              
    102                                                  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    103                                                  task run_phase(uvm_phase phase);
    104                                                      reset_counters();
    105                                                      fork
    106                                                          monitor_reg_writes();
    107                                                          monitor_mem_ops();
    108                                                          monitor_branches();
    109                                                          monitor_stalls();
    110                                                          monitor_cache();
    111                                                      join
    112                                                  endtask
    113                                              
    114                                                  task reset_counters();
    115                                                      total_cycles  = 0; instr_retired = 0;
    116                                                      stall_cycles  = 0; branch_count  = 0;
    117                                                      mispredicts   = 0; cache_misses  = 0;
    118                                                  endtask
    119                                              
    120                                                  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    121                                                  task monitor_reg_writes();
    122                                                      forever begin
    123                                                          @(vif.mon_cb);
    124                                                          if (!vif.mon_cb.rst_n) continue;
    125                                                          if(vif.InstrDM==32'h0000006F)
    126                                                              en=1;
    127                                                          
    128                                                          if (en!=1'd1)
    129                                                              total_cycles++;
    130                                              
    131                                                          if (vif.mon_cb.RegWriteW && vif.mon_cb.RDW != 5'h0) begin
    132                                                              reg_write_txn t = reg_write_txn::type_id::create("rwt");
    133                                                              t.rd = vif.mon_cb.RDW; t.data = vif.mon_cb.ResultW; t.is_fp = 0;
    134                                                              ap_reg_write.write(t);
    135                                                              if (cfg.log_every_reg_write)
    136                                                                  `uvm_info("MON", t.convert2string(), UVM_LOW)
    137                                                          end
    138                                              
    139                                                          if (vif.mon_cb.FRegWriteMW) begin
    140                                                              reg_write_txn t = reg_write_txn::type_id::create("frwt");
    141                                                              t.rd   = vif.mon_cb.RDW;
    142                                                              t.data = vif.mon_cb.FResultW;
    143                                                              t.is_fp = 1;
    144                                                              ap_reg_write.write(t);
    145                                                          end
    146                                              
    147                                                          if (vif.mon_cb.InstrD != 32'h00000013 &&
    148                                                              vif.mon_cb.InstrD != 32'h0          &&
    149                                                              vif.mon_cb.InstrD != 32'h0000006F   &&
    150                                                              !vif.mon_cb.StallD)
    151                                                              instr_retired++;
    152                                                      end
    153                                                  endtask
    154                                              
    155                                                  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    156                                                  task monitor_mem_ops();
    157                                                      forever begin
    158                                                          @(vif.mon_cb);
    159                                                          if (!vif.mon_cb.rst_n) continue;
    160                                                          if (vif.mon_cb.MemWriteM) begin
    161                                                              mem_txn t = mem_txn::type_id::create("mt");
    162                                                              t.addr = vif.mon_cb.ALU_ResultM;
    163                                                              t.data = vif.mon_cb.WriteDataM;
    164                                                              t.is_write = 1;
    165                                                              ap_mem.write(t);
    166                                                              if (cfg.log_every_mem_write)
    167                                                                  `uvm_info("MON", t.convert2string(), UVM_LOW)
    168                                                          end
    169                                                      end
    170                                                  endtask
    171                                              
    172                                                  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    173                                                  task monitor_branches();
    174                                                      forever begin
    175                                                          @(vif.mon_cb);
    176                                                          if (!vif.mon_cb.rst_n) continue;
    177                                                          if (vif.mon_cb.BranchE) begin
    178                                                              branch_txn t = branch_txn::type_id::create("bt");
    179                                                              t.pc           = vif.mon_cb.PCD;
    180                                                              t.target       = vif.mon_cb.PCTargetE;
    181                                                              t.taken        = vif.mon_cb.PCSrcE;
    182                                                              t.mispredicted = vif.mon_cb.mispredict;
    183                                                              ap_branch.write(t);
    184                                                              branch_count++;
    185                                                              if (vif.mispredict) begin
    186                                                                  mispredicts++;
    187                                                                  if (cfg.track_mispredicts)
    188                                                                      `uvm_info("MON", $sformatf("MISPREDICT: %s", t.convert2string()), UVM_MEDIUM)
    189                                                              end
    190                                                          end
    191                                                      end
    192                                                  endtask
    193                                              
    194                                                  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    195                                                  task monitor_stalls();
    196                                                      forever begin
    197                                                          @(vif.mon_cb);
    198                                                          if (!vif.mon_cb.rst_n) continue;
    199                                                          if ($isunknown(vif.mon_cb.InstrD)) continue;  // past program end
    200                                                          if (vif.mon_cb.StallF || vif.mon_cb.StallD || vif.mon_cb.stall)
    201                                                              stall_cycles++;
    202                                                      end
    203                                                  endtask
    204                                              
    205                                                  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    206                                                  task monitor_cache();
    207                                                      logic [2:0] prev_state = 0;
    208                                                      forever begin
    209                                                          @(vif.mon_cb);
    210                                                          if (!vif.mon_cb.rst_n) begin prev_state = 0; continue; end
    211                                                          if (prev_state != 3'd3 && vif.mon_cb.cache_state == 3'd3) begin
    212                                                              cache_misses++;
    213                                                              if (cfg.detailed_cache_stats)
    214                                                                  `uvm_info("MON",
    215                                                                      $sformatf("CACHE MISS #%0d", cache_misses), UVM_LOW)
    216                                                          end
    217                                                          prev_state = vif.mon_cb.cache_state;
    218                                                      end
    219                                                  endtask
    220                                              
    221                                                  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    222                                                  function void publish_stats();
    223                                                      pipeline_stats_txn s = pipeline_stats_txn::type_id::create("stats");
    224                                                      s.total_cycles  = total_cycles;
    225                                                      s.instr_retired = instr_retired;
    226                                                      s.stall_cycles  = stall_cycles;
    227                                                      s.branch_count  = branch_count;
    228                                                      s.mispredicts   = mispredicts;
    229                                                      s.cache_misses  = cache_misses;
    230                                                      s.ipc = (total_cycles > 0) ?
    231                                                                  real'(instr_retired) / real'(total_cycles) : 0.0;
    232                                                      ap_stats.write(s);
    233                                                      `uvm_info("MON", s.convert2string(), UVM_LOW)
    234                                                  endfunction
    235                                              
    236                                                 task reset_for_new_program();
    237                                                  en = 0;
    238                                              endtask
    239                                              endclass : riscv_monitor
    5                                                class reg_write_txn extends uvm_sequence_item;
    6                                                    `uvm_object_utils(reg_write_txn)
    7                                                    logic [4:0]  rd;
    8                                                    logic [31:0] data;
    9                                                    logic [31:0] pc;
    10                                                   bit          is_fp;
    11                                                   function new(string name="reg_write_txn"); super.new(name); endfunction
    12                                                   function string convert2string();
    13                                                       return $sformatf("%s[%0d]=0x%08h @ PC=0x%08h", is_fp?"f":"x", rd, data, pc);
    14                                                   endfunction
    15                                               endclass
    16

    55                                                           total_cycles, instr_retired, stall_cycles, ipc,

    71

    74                                                   int unsigned instr_retired;

    99                                                       ap_stats     = new("ap_stats",     this);
    100                                                  endfunction
    101                                              
    102                                                  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    103                                                  task run_phase(uvm_phase phase);
    104                                                      reset_counters();
    105                                                      fork
    106                                                          monitor_reg_writes();
    107                                                          monitor_mem_ops();
    108                                                          monitor_branches();
    109                                                          monitor_stalls();
    110                                                          monitor_cache();
    111                                                      join
    112                                                  endtask
    113                                              
    114                                                  task reset_counters();
    115                                                      total_cycles  = 0; instr_retired = 0;
    116                                                      stall_cycles  = 0; branch_count  = 0;
    117                                                      mispredicts   = 0; cache_misses  = 0;
    118                                                  endtask
    119                                              
    120                                                  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    121                                                  task monitor_reg_writes();
    122                                                      forever begin
    123                                                          @(vif.mon_cb);
    124                                                          if (!vif.mon_cb.rst_n) continue;
    125                                                          if(vif.InstrDM==32'h0000006F)
    126                                                              en=1;
    127                                                          
    128                                                          if (en!=1'd1)
    129                                                              total_cycles++;
    130                                              
    131                                                          if (vif.mon_cb.RegWriteW && vif.mon_cb.RDW != 5'h0) begin
    132                                                              reg_write_txn t = reg_write_txn::type_id::create("rwt");
    133                                                              t.rd = vif.mon_cb.RDW; t.data = vif.mon_cb.ResultW; t.is_fp = 0;
    134                                                              ap_reg_write.write(t);
    135                                                              if (cfg.log_every_reg_write)
    136                                                                  `uvm_info("MON", t.convert2string(), UVM_LOW)
    137                                                          end
    138                                              
    139                                                          if (vif.mon_cb.FRegWriteMW) begin
    140                                                              reg_write_txn t = reg_write_txn::type_id::create("frwt");
    141                                                              t.rd   = vif.mon_cb.RDW;
    142                                                              t.data = vif.mon_cb.FResultW;
    143                                                              t.is_fp = 1;
    144                                                              ap_reg_write.write(t);
    145                                                          end
    146                                              
    147                                                          if (vif.mon_cb.InstrD != 32'h00000013 &&
    148                                                              vif.mon_cb.InstrD != 32'h0          &&
    149                                                              vif.mon_cb.InstrD != 32'h0000006F   &&
    150                                                              !vif.mon_cb.StallD)
    151                                                              instr_retired++;
    152                                                      end
    153                                                  endtask
    154                                              
    155                                                  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    156                                                  task monitor_mem_ops();
    157                                                      forever begin
    158                                                          @(vif.mon_cb);
    159                                                          if (!vif.mon_cb.rst_n) continue;
    160                                                          if (vif.mon_cb.MemWriteM) begin
    161                                                              mem_txn t = mem_txn::type_id::create("mt");
    162                                                              t.addr = vif.mon_cb.ALU_ResultM;
    163                                                              t.data = vif.mon_cb.WriteDataM;
    164                                                              t.is_write = 1;
    165                                                              ap_mem.write(t);

    181                                                              t.taken        = vif.mon_cb.PCSrcE;

    201                                                              stall_cycles++;

    203                                                  endtask

    208                                                      forever begin
    209                                                          @(vif.mon_cb);
    210                                                          if (!vif.mon_cb.rst_n) begin prev_state = 0; continue; end
    211                                                          if (prev_state != 3'd3 && vif.mon_cb.cache_state == 3'd3) begin
    212                                                              cache_misses++;
    213                                                              if (cfg.detailed_cache_stats)
    214                                                                  `uvm_info("MON",
    215                                                                      $sformatf("CACHE MISS #%0d", cache_misses), UVM_LOW)

    231                                                                  real'(instr_retired) / real'(total_cycles) : 0.0;

    234                                                  endfunction

    5                                                class reg_write_txn extends uvm_sequence_item;
    6                                                    `uvm_object_utils(reg_write_txn)
    7                                                    logic [4:0]  rd;

    14                                                   endfunction

    17                                               class mem_txn extends uvm_sequence_item;
    18                                                   `uvm_object_utils(mem_txn)
    19                                                   logic [31:0] addr;

    22                                                   function new(string name="mem_txn"); super.new(name); endfunction
    23                                                   function string convert2string();
    24                                                       return $sformatf("MEM_%s addr=0x%08h data=0x%08h",
    25                                                                        is_write?"WR":"RD", addr, data);
    26                                                   endfunction
    27                                               endclass
    28                                               
    29                                               class branch_txn extends uvm_sequence_item;
    30                                                   `uvm_object_utils(branch_txn)
    31                                                   logic [31:0] pc;
    32                                                   logic [31:0] target;
    33                                                   bit          taken;
    34                                                   bit          mispredicted;
    35                                                   function new(string name="branch_txn"); super.new(name); endfunction
    36                                                   function string convert2string();
    37                                                       return $sformatf("BRANCH @ 0x%08h %s target=0x%08h mispredict=%0b",
    38                                                                        pc, taken?"TAKEN":"NOT_TAKEN", target, mispredicted);
    39                                                   endfunction
    40                                               endclass
    41

    43                                                   `uvm_object_utils(pipeline_stats_txn)
    44                                                   int unsigned total_cycles;
    45                                                   int unsigned instr_retired;
    46                                                   int unsigned stall_cycles;
    47                                                   int unsigned branch_count;
    48                                                   int unsigned mispredicts;
    49                                                   int unsigned cache_misses;
    50                                                   real         ipc;
    51                                                   function new(string name="pipeline_stats_txn"); super.new(name); endfunction
    52                                                   function string convert2string();
    53                                                       return $sformatf(
    54                                                           "STATS: cycles=%0d retired=%0d stalls=%0d IPC=%.3f branches=%0d mispredict=%0d cache_miss=%0d",
    55                                                           total_cycles, instr_retired, stall_cycles, ipc,
    56                                                           branch_count, mispredicts, cache_misses);
    57                                                   endfunction

    59                                               
    60                                               // ===========================================================================
    61                                               class riscv_monitor extends uvm_monitor;
    62                                                   `uvm_component_utils(riscv_monitor)
    63                                               
    64                                                   virtual riscv_if  vif;
    65                                                   riscv_env_config  cfg;
    66                                               
    67                                                   uvm_analysis_port #(reg_write_txn)      ap_reg_write;
    68                                                   uvm_analysis_port #(mem_txn)            ap_mem;
    69                                                   uvm_analysis_port #(branch_txn)         ap_branch;
    70                                                   uvm_analysis_port #(pipeline_stats_txn) ap_stats;
    71                                               
    72                                                   // Internal counters
    73                                                   int unsigned total_cycles;
    74                                                   int unsigned instr_retired;
    75                                                   int unsigned stall_cycles;
    76                                                   int unsigned branch_count;
    77                                                   int unsigned mispredicts;
    78                                                   int unsigned cache_misses;
    79                                                   bit en;
    80                                                   function new(string name, uvm_component parent);
    81                                                       super.new(name, parent);
    82                                                   endfunction
    83                                               
    84                                                   // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    85                                                   function void build_phase(uvm_phase phase);
    86                                                       super.build_phase(phase);
    87                                               
    88                                                       // Read config object — get vif and all monitoring knobs from it
    89                                                       if (!uvm_config_db #(riscv_env_config)::get(this, "", "cfg", cfg))
    90                                                           `uvm_fatal("NOCFG", "riscv_monitor: riscv_env_config not found")
    91                                               
    92                                                       vif = cfg.vif;
    93                                                       if (vif == null)
    94                                                           `uvm_fatal("NOVIF", "riscv_monitor: cfg.vif is null")
    95                                               
    96                                                       ap_reg_write = new("ap_reg_write", this);
    97                                                       ap_mem       = new("ap_mem",       this);
    98                                                       ap_branch    = new("ap_branch",    this);
    99                                                       ap_stats     = new("ap_stats",     this);
    100                                                  endfunction
    101                                              
    102                                                  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    103                                                  task run_phase(uvm_phase phase);
    104                                                      reset_counters();
    105                                                      fork
    106                                                          monitor_reg_writes();
    107                                                          monitor_mem_ops();
    108                                                          monitor_branches();
    109                                                          monitor_stalls();
    110                                                          monitor_cache();
    111                                                      join
    112                                                  endtask
    113                                              
    114                                                  task reset_counters();
    115                                                      total_cycles  = 0; instr_retired = 0;
    116                                                      stall_cycles  = 0; branch_count  = 0;
    117                                                      mispredicts   = 0; cache_misses  = 0;
    118                                                  endtask
    119                                              
    120                                                  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    121                                                  task monitor_reg_writes();
    122                                                      forever begin
    123                                                          @(vif.mon_cb);
    124                                                          if (!vif.mon_cb.rst_n) continue;
    125                                                          if(vif.InstrDM==32'h0000006F)
    126                                                              en=1;
    127                                                          
    128                                                          if (en!=1'd1)
    129                                                              total_cycles++;
    130                                              
    131                                                          if (vif.mon_cb.RegWriteW && vif.mon_cb.RDW != 5'h0) begin
    132                                                              reg_write_txn t = reg_write_txn::type_id::create("rwt");
    133                                                              t.rd = vif.mon_cb.RDW; t.data = vif.mon_cb.ResultW; t.is_fp = 0;
    134                                                              ap_reg_write.write(t);
    135                                                              if (cfg.log_every_reg_write)
    136                                                                  `uvm_info("MON", t.convert2string(), UVM_LOW)
    137                                                          end
    138                                              
    139                                                          if (vif.mon_cb.FRegWriteMW) begin
    140                                                              reg_write_txn t = reg_write_txn::type_id::create("frwt");
    141                                                              t.rd   = vif.mon_cb.RDW;
    142                                                              t.data = vif.mon_cb.FResultW;
    143                                                              t.is_fp = 1;
    144                                                              ap_reg_write.write(t);
    145                                                          end
    146                                              
    147                                                          if (vif.mon_cb.InstrD != 32'h00000013 &&
    148                                                              vif.mon_cb.InstrD != 32'h0          &&
    149                                                              vif.mon_cb.InstrD != 32'h0000006F   &&
    150                                                              !vif.mon_cb.StallD)
    151                                                              instr_retired++;
    152                                                      end
    153                                                  endtask
    154                                              
    155                                                  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    156                                                  task monitor_mem_ops();
    157                                                      forever begin
    158                                                          @(vif.mon_cb);
    159                                                          if (!vif.mon_cb.rst_n) continue;
    160                                                          if (vif.mon_cb.MemWriteM) begin
    161                                                              mem_txn t = mem_txn::type_id::create("mt");
    162                                                              t.addr = vif.mon_cb.ALU_ResultM;
    163                                                              t.data = vif.mon_cb.WriteDataM;
    164                                                              t.is_write = 1;
    165                                                              ap_mem.write(t);
    166                                                              if (cfg.log_every_mem_write)
    167                                                                  `uvm_info("MON", t.convert2string(), UVM_LOW)
    168                                                          end
    169                                                      end
    170                                                  endtask
    171                                              
    172                                                  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    173                                                  task monitor_branches();
    174                                                      forever begin
    175                                                          @(vif.mon_cb);
    176                                                          if (!vif.mon_cb.rst_n) continue;
    177                                                          if (vif.mon_cb.BranchE) begin
    178                                                              branch_txn t = branch_txn::type_id::create("bt");
    179                                                              t.pc           = vif.mon_cb.PCD;
    180                                                              t.target       = vif.mon_cb.PCTargetE;
    181                                                              t.taken        = vif.mon_cb.PCSrcE;
    182                                                              t.mispredicted = vif.mon_cb.mispredict;
    183                                                              ap_branch.write(t);
    184                                                              branch_count++;
    185                                                              if (vif.mispredict) begin
    186                                                                  mispredicts++;
    187                                                                  if (cfg.track_mispredicts)
    188                                                                      `uvm_info("MON", $sformatf("MISPREDICT: %s", t.convert2string()), UVM_MEDIUM)
    189                                                              end
    190                                                          end
    191                                                      end
    192                                                  endtask
    193                                              
    194                                                  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    195                                                  task monitor_stalls();
    196                                                      forever begin
    197                                                          @(vif.mon_cb);
    198                                                          if (!vif.mon_cb.rst_n) continue;
    199                                                          if ($isunknown(vif.mon_cb.InstrD)) continue;  // past program end
    200                                                          if (vif.mon_cb.StallF || vif.mon_cb.StallD || vif.mon_cb.stall)
    201                                                              stall_cycles++;
    202                                                      end
    203                                                  endtask
    204                                              
    205                                                  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    206                                                  task monitor_cache();
    207                                                      logic [2:0] prev_state = 0;
    208                                                      forever begin
    209                                                          @(vif.mon_cb);
    210                                                          if (!vif.mon_cb.rst_n) begin prev_state = 0; continue; end
    211                                                          if (prev_state != 3'd3 && vif.mon_cb.cache_state == 3'd3) begin
    212                                                              cache_misses++;
    213                                                              if (cfg.detailed_cache_stats)
    214                                                                  `uvm_info("MON",
    215                                                                      $sformatf("CACHE MISS #%0d", cache_misses), UVM_LOW)
    216                                                          end
    217                                                          prev_state = vif.mon_cb.cache_state;
    218                                                      end
    219                                                  endtask
    220                                              
    221                                                  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    222                                                  function void publish_stats();
    223                                                      pipeline_stats_txn s = pipeline_stats_txn::type_id::create("stats");
    224                                                      s.total_cycles  = total_cycles;
    225                                                      s.instr_retired = instr_retired;
    226                                                      s.stall_cycles  = stall_cycles;
    227                                                      s.branch_count  = branch_count;
    228                                                      s.mispredicts   = mispredicts;
    229                                                      s.cache_misses  = cache_misses;
    230                                                      s.ipc = (total_cycles > 0) ?
    231                                                                  real'(instr_retired) / real'(total_cycles) : 0.0;
    232                                                      ap_stats.write(s);
    233                                                      `uvm_info("MON", s.convert2string(), UVM_LOW)
    234                                                  endfunction
    235                                              
    236                                                 task reset_for_new_program();
    237                                                  en = 0;
    238                                              endtask
    239                                              endclass : riscv_monitor
    5                                                class reg_write_txn extends uvm_sequence_item;

    10                                                   bit          is_fp;

    14                                                   endfunction

    5                                                class riscv_scoreboard extends uvm_scoreboard;
    6                                                    `uvm_component_utils(riscv_scoreboard)

    12                                               
    13                                                   riscv_env_config  cfg;
    14                                                   riscv_seq_item    expected;   // set by test after build_phase
    15                                               
    16                                                   // Shadow models

    18                                                   logic [31:0] shadow_fp [32];
    19                                                   logic [31:0] shadow_mem[bit [31:0]];   // bit index — 2-state, legal
    20

    22                                                   int unsigned fail_count;

    27                                                   bit          prologue_checked;      // fires prologue check exactly once

    36                                               
    37                                                       if (!uvm_config_db #(riscv_env_config)::get(this, "", "cfg", cfg))
    38                                                           `uvm_fatal("NOCFG", "riscv_scoreboard: riscv_env_config not found")
    39

    48                                                   function void reset_shadows();
    49                                                       foreach (shadow_int[i]) shadow_int[i] = 0;
    50                                                       foreach (shadow_fp[i])  shadow_fp[i]  = 0;
    51                                                       shadow_mem.delete();
    52                                                       pass_count = 0; fail_count = 0; check_count = 0;
    53                                                       reg_write_count = 0; prologue_checked = 0;
    54                                                   endfunction

    58                                               function void write_reg(reg_write_txn t);
    59                                                   if (!t.is_fp) begin
    60                                                       if (t.rd != 0) shadow_int[t.rd] = t.data;
    61                                                   end else begin
    62                                                       shadow_fp[t.rd] = t.data;
    63                                                   end
    64                                                   reg_write_count++;
    65                                                   // Guard on BOTH config mode AND that no expected item overrides (directed hex)
    66                                                   if (!prologue_checked && reg_write_count >= 14 &&
    67                                                       cfg.stim_mode == riscv_env_config::RANDOM_PROGRAM &&
    68                                                       (expected == null || expected.stim_mode == riscv_seq_item::RANDOM_PROGRAM)) begin
    69                                                       prologue_checked = 1;
    70                                                       check_prologue_regs();
    71                                                   end
    72                                               endfunction

    74                                                       if (t.is_write) shadow_mem[bit'(t.addr)] = t.data;
    75                                                   endfunction

    78                                                       // Accumulated in monitor; no per-branch action needed here
    79                                                   endfunction

    82                                                   function void write_stats(pipeline_stats_txn s);

    84                                               
    85                                                       if (expected == null) begin
    86                                                           `uvm_info("SB","No exp_int_regs set — skipping end-of-program register check.",UVM_MEDIUM)
    87                                                       end else begin
    88                                                           if (cfg.enable_reg_checks) check_registers();
    89                                                           if (cfg.enable_mem_checks) check_memory();
    90                                                       end
    91                                                       // IPC check runs for all tests that have a min_ipc threshold
    92                                                       if (cfg.enable_ipc_check) check_ipc(s);
    93

    95                                                       check_x0_zero();
    96
