    100                                                  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    101                                                  function void check_registers();
    102                                                      for (int i = 1; i < 32; i++) begin
    103                                                          if (expected.exp_int_regs[i] === 32'hX) continue;
    104                                                          check_count++;
    105                                                          if (shadow_int[i] !== expected.exp_int_regs[i]) begin
    106                                                              `uvm_error("SB",
    107                                                                  $sformatf("INT REG MISMATCH x%0d: got=0x%08h exp=0x%08h",
    108                                                                            i, shadow_int[i], expected.exp_int_regs[i]))
    109                                                              fail_count++;
    110                                                          end else pass_count++;
    111                                                      end
    112                                                      for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) begin
    113                                                          if (expected.exp_fp_regs[i] === 32'hX) continue;
    114                                                          check_count++;
    115                                                          if (shadow_fp[i] !== expected.exp_fp_regs[i]) begin
    116                                                              `uvm_error("SB",
    117                                                                  $sformatf("FP REG MISMATCH f%0d: got=0x%08h exp=0x%08h",
    118                                                                            i, shadow_fp[i], expected.exp_fp_regs[i]))
    119                                                              fail_count++;
    120                                                          end else pass_count++;
    121                                                      end
    122                                                  endfunction
    123                                              
    124                                                  function void check_memory();
    125                                                      foreach (expected.exp_mem[addr]) begin
    126                                                          check_count++;
    127                                                          if (!shadow_mem.exists(addr)) begin
    128                                                              `uvm_error("SB",
    129                                                                  $sformatf("MEM CHECK: addr 0x%08h never written (exp=0x%08h)",
    130                                                                            addr, expected.exp_mem[addr]))
    131                                                              fail_count++;
    132                                                          end else if (shadow_mem[addr] !== expected.exp_mem[addr]) begin
    133                                                              `uvm_error("SB",
    134                                                                  $sformatf("MEM MISMATCH addr=0x%08h got=0x%08h exp=0x%08h",
    135                                                                            addr, shadow_mem[addr], expected.exp_mem[addr]))
    136                                                              fail_count++;
    137                                                          end else pass_count++;
    138                                                      end
    139                                                  endfunction
    140                                              
    141                                                  function void check_ipc(pipeline_stats_txn s);
    142                                                      real effective_min = (expected != null && expected.min_ipc > 0.0)
    143                                                                           ? expected.min_ipc : cfg.min_ipc;
    144                                                      if (effective_min <= 0.0) return;
    145                                                      check_count++;
    146                                                      if (s.ipc < effective_min) begin
    147                                                          `uvm_error("SB",
    148                                                              $sformatf("IPC FAIL: got=%.3f min=%.3f", s.ipc, effective_min))
    149                                                          fail_count++;
    150                                                      end else begin
    151                                                          `uvm_info("SB",
    152                                                              $sformatf("IPC PASS: %.3f >= %.3f", s.ipc, effective_min), UVM_LOW)
    153                                                          pass_count++;
    154                                                      end
    155                                                  endfunction
    156                                              
    157                                                 
    158                                                  function void check_prologue_regs();
    159                                                      // x1-x7: known seed values
    160                                                      for (int r = 1; r <= 7; r++) begin
    161                                                          check_count++;
    162                                                          if (shadow_int[r] !== 32'(r)) begin
    163                                                              `uvm_error("SB", $sformatf(
    164                                                                  "PROLOGUE FAIL x%0d: got=0x%08h exp=0x%08h (after prologue)",
    165                                                                  r, shadow_int[r], 32'(r)))
    166                                                              fail_count++;
    167                                                          end else pass_count++;
    168                                                      end
    169                                                      // x8: base address (prologue uses LUI only for upper 20 bits; lower 12=0)
    170                                                      check_count++;
    171                                                      if (shadow_int[8] !== 32'h10000000) begin
    172                                                          `uvm_error("SB", $sformatf(
    173                                                              "PROLOGUE FAIL x8: got=0x%08h exp=0x10000000 (data base ptr)",
    174                                                              shadow_int[8]))
    175                                                          fail_count++;
    176                                                      end else pass_count++;
    177                                                      // x9 = 1.0f, x10 = 2.0f
    178                                                      check_count++;
    179                                                      if (shadow_int[9] !== 32'h3F800000) begin
    180                                                          `uvm_error("SB", $sformatf(
    181                                                              "PROLOGUE FAIL x9: got=0x%08h exp=0x3F800000 (1.0f seed)",
    182                                                              shadow_int[9]))
    183                                                          fail_count++;
    184                                                      end else pass_count++;
    185                                                      check_count++;
    186                                                      if (shadow_int[10] !== 32'h40000000) begin
    187                                                          `uvm_error("SB", $sformatf(
    188                                                              "PROLOGUE FAIL x10: got=0x%08h exp=0x40000000 (2.0f seed)",
    189                                                              shadow_int[10]))
    190                                                          fail_count++;
    191                                                      end else pass_count++;
    192                                                      `uvm_info("SB", $sformatf(
    193                                                          "Prologue check done: %0d passed, %0d failed",
    194                                                          pass_count, fail_count), UVM_MEDIUM)
    195                                                  endfunction
    196                                              
    197                                                  function void check_x0_zero();
    198                                                      check_count++;
    199                                                      if (shadow_int[0] !== 32'h0) begin
    200                                                          `uvm_error("SB", $sformatf("x0 != 0! (got 0x%08h)", shadow_int[0]))
    201                                                          fail_count++;
    202                                                      end else pass_count++;
    203                                                  endfunction
    204                                              
    205                                                  function void print_summary();
    206                                                      `uvm_info("SB", $sformatf("\n============================================================\n  SCOREBOARD SUMMARY\n  Total Checks : %0d\n  PASSED       : %0d\n  FAILED       : %0d\n============================================================", check_count, pass_count, fail_count), UVM_LOW)
    207                                                  endfunction
    208                                              
    209                                                  function void report_phase(uvm_phase phase);
    210                                                      if (fail_count > 0)
    211                                                          `uvm_error("SB", $sformatf("TEST FAILED: %0d check(s) failed", fail_count))
    212                                                      else if (check_count > 0)
    213                                                          `uvm_info("SB", "ALL CHECKS PASSED", UVM_NONE)
    214                                                  endfunction

    150                                              class riscv_reset_stress_seq extends uvm_sequence #(riscv_seq_item);
    151                                                  `uvm_object_utils(riscv_reset_stress_seq)
    152                                                  int unsigned iterations = 5;
    153                                                  function new(string name = "riscv_reset_stress_seq"); super.new(name); endfunction
    154                                              
    155                                                  task body();
    156                                                      for (int i = 0; i < iterations; i++) begin
    157                                                          riscv_seq_item item = riscv_seq_item::type_id::create($sformatf("item_%0d",i));
    158                                                          start_item(item);
    159                                                          if (!item.randomize() with {
    160                                                              run_cycles   inside {[100:500]};
    161                                                              reset_cycles inside {[2:8]};
    162                                                              num_instrs   inside {[20:60]};
    163                                                              stim_mode    == RANDOM_PROGRAM;
    164                                                          }) `uvm_fatal("SEQ","reset_stress randomize failed")
    165                                                          `uvm_info("SEQ",$sformatf("Reset iter %0d: %s",i,item.convert2string()),UVM_MEDIUM)
    166                                                          finish_item(item);
    167                                                      end
    168                                                  endtask
    169                                              endclass

    184                                                      finish_item(item);
    185                                                  endtask

    20                                                       if (!item.randomize())
    21                                                           `uvm_fatal("SEQ","Randomization failed")

    6                                                
    7                                                    riscv_env        env;
    8                                                    riscv_env_config cfg;
    9                                                 virtual riscv_if vif;
    10                                                   function new(string name, uvm_component parent);
    11                                                       super.new(name, parent);
    12                                                   endfunction
    13                                               
    14                                                 
    15                                                   function void build_phase(uvm_phase phase);
    16                                                      
    17                                               
    18                                                       // 1. Create config object
    19                                                       cfg = riscv_env_config::type_id::create("cfg");
    20                                               
    21                                                       // 2. Pull vif from config_db (set by tb_top)
    22                                                       if (!uvm_config_db #(virtual riscv_if)::get(this, "", "vif", vif))
    23                                                           `uvm_fatal("NOVIF", "riscv_base_test: vif not in config_db")
    24                                                       cfg.vif = vif;
    25                                               
    26                                                       // 3. Apply defaults — child overrides these before calling super
    27                                                       apply_config();
    28                                               
    29                                                       // 4. Validate knobs
    30                                                       cfg.validate();
    31                                               
    32                                                       // 5. Push into config_db so env + all children can get it
    33                                                       uvm_config_db #(riscv_env_config)::set(this, "env*", "cfg", cfg);
    34                                               
    35                                                       // 6. Now build env (it will find cfg in config_db)
    36                                                       super.build_phase(phase);
    37                                                       env = riscv_env::type_id::create("env", this);
    38                                                   endfunction
    39                                               
    40                                                   // Override in child to set cfg fields
    41                                                   virtual function void apply_config();
    42                                                       // base defaults are already set in riscv_env_config constructor
    43                                                   endfunction
    44                                               
    45                                                   // Override in child to set scoreboard expected values
    46                                                   virtual function void configure_scoreboard();
    47                                                   endfunction
    48                                               
    49                                                   // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    50                                                   task run_phase(uvm_phase phase);
    51                                                       phase.raise_objection(this, "test running");
    52                                                       configure_scoreboard();
    53                                                       run_sequences();
    54                                                       #100;
    55                                                       env.agent.monitor.publish_stats();
    56                                                       phase.drop_objection(this, "test done");
    57                                                   endtask
    58                                               
    59                                                   virtual task run_sequences();
    60                                                       `uvm_fatal("BASE","run_sequences() not implemented")
    61                                                   endtask

    302                                              class riscv_regression_test extends riscv_base_test;
    303                                                  `uvm_component_utils(riscv_regression_test)
    304                                              
    305                                                  function new(string name, uvm_component parent);
    306                                                      super.new(name, parent);
    307                                                  endfunction
    308                                              
    309                                                  function void apply_config();
    310                                                      
    311                                                      cfg.stim_mode     = riscv_env_config::RANDOM_PROGRAM;
    312                                                      cfg.run_cycles    = 500000;
    313                                                      cfg.min_ipc       = 0.0;    // checked per-sequence
    314                                                      cfg.enable_ipc_check  = 0;
    315                                                      cfg.track_mispredicts = 1;
    316                                                      cfg.enable_reg_checks = 1;
    317                                                      cfg.enable_mem_checks = 1;
    318                                                      cfg.detailed_cache_stats = 1;
    319                                                      cfg.verbosity     = UVM_LOW;
    320                                                  endfunction
    321                                              
    322                                                  function void configure_scoreboard();
    323                                                      env.scoreboard.expected = riscv_seq_item::type_id::create("exp");
    324                                                      // Sentinel set only for the directed phase
    325                                                      env.scoreboard.expected.exp_int_regs[30] = 32'hX;  // don't care initially
    326                                                  endfunction
    327                                              
    328                                                  task run_sequences();
    329                                                      // Phase 1: directed hex
    330                                                      begin
    331                                                          riscv_full_test_seq seq;
    332                                                          `uvm_info("TEST","== Regression Phase 1: Directed hex ==",UVM_NONE)
    333                                                          env.scoreboard.expected.exp_int_regs[30] = 32'h0DEADBEF;
    334                                                          seq = riscv_full_test_seq::type_id::create("p1");
    335                                                          seq.start(env.agent.sequencer);
    336                                                          env.scoreboard.expected.exp_int_regs[30] = 32'hX;
    337                                                      end
    338                                                      env.scoreboard.prologue_checked = 0;
    339                                                      env.scoreboard.reg_write_count  = 0;
    340                                                      // Phase 2: int ALU random
    341                                                      begin
    342                                                          riscv_int_alu_seq seq;
    343                                                          `uvm_info("TEST","== Regression Phase 2: Int ALU ==",UVM_NONE)
    344                                                          seq = riscv_int_alu_seq::type_id::create("p2");
    345                                                          seq.start(env.agent.sequencer);
    346                                                      end
    347                                                      env.scoreboard.prologue_checked = 0;
    348                                              env.scoreboard.reg_write_count  = 0;
    349                                                      // Phase 3: load/store
    350                                                      begin
    351                                                          riscv_load_store_seq seq;
    352                                                          `uvm_info("TEST","== Regression Phase 3: Load/Store ==",UVM_NONE)
    353                                                          seq = riscv_load_store_seq::type_id::create("p3");
    354                                                          seq.start(env.agent.sequencer);
    355                                                      end
    356                                              env.scoreboard.prologue_checked = 0;
    357                                              env.scoreboard.reg_write_count  = 0;
    358                                                      // Phase 4: branch stress
    359                                                      begin
    360                                                          riscv_branch_stress_seq seq;
    361                                                          `uvm_info("TEST","== Regression Phase 4: Branch ==",UVM_NONE)
    362                                                          seq = riscv_branch_stress_seq::type_id::create("p4");
    363                                                          seq.start(env.agent.sequencer);
    364                                                      end
    365                                              
    366                                                      // Phase 5: FPU
    367                                                      begin
    368                                                          riscv_fpu_seq seq;
    369                                                          `uvm_info("TEST","== Regression Phase 5: FPU ==",UVM_NONE)
    370                                                          seq = riscv_fpu_seq::type_id::create("p5");
    371                                                          seq.start(env.agent.sequencer);
    372                                                      end
    373                                              env.scoreboard.prologue_checked = 0;
    374                                              env.scoreboard.reg_write_count  = 0;
    375                                                      // Phase 6: reset stress
    376                                                      begin
    377                                                          riscv_reset_stress_seq seq;
    378                                                          `uvm_info("TEST","== Regression Phase 6: Reset stress ==",UVM_NONE)
    379                                                          seq = riscv_reset_stress_seq::type_id::create("p6");
    380                                                          seq.iterations = 3;
    381                                                          seq.start(env.agent.sequencer);
    382                                                      end
    383                                                  endtask
    384                                              
    385                                              endclass
    5                                                    `uvm_component_utils(riscv_base_test)
    6                                                
    7                                                    riscv_env        env;
    8                                                    riscv_env_config cfg;
    9                                                 virtual riscv_if vif;
    10                                                   function new(string name, uvm_component parent);
    11                                                       super.new(name, parent);
    12                                                   endfunction
    13                                               
    14                                                 
    15                                                   function void build_phase(uvm_phase phase);
    16                                                      
    17                                               
    18                                                       // 1. Create config object
    19                                                       cfg = riscv_env_config::type_id::create("cfg");
    20                                               
    21                                                       // 2. Pull vif from config_db (set by tb_top)
    22                                                       if (!uvm_config_db #(virtual riscv_if)::get(this, "", "vif", vif))
    23                                                           `uvm_fatal("NOVIF", "riscv_base_test: vif not in config_db")
    24                                                       cfg.vif = vif;
    25                                               
    26                                                       // 3. Apply defaults — child overrides these before calling super
    27                                                       apply_config();
    28                                               
    29                                                       // 4. Validate knobs
    30                                                       cfg.validate();
    31                                               
    32                                                       // 5. Push into config_db so env + all children can get it
    33                                                       uvm_config_db #(riscv_env_config)::set(this, "env*", "cfg", cfg);
    34                                               
    35                                                       // 6. Now build env (it will find cfg in config_db)
    36                                                       super.build_phase(phase);
    37                                                       env = riscv_env::type_id::create("env", this);
    38                                                   endfunction
    39                                               
    40                                                   // Override in child to set cfg fields
    41                                                   virtual function void apply_config();
    42                                                       // base defaults are already set in riscv_env_config constructor
    43                                                   endfunction
    44                                               
    45                                                   // Override in child to set scoreboard expected values
    46                                                   virtual function void configure_scoreboard();
    47                                                   endfunction
    48                                               
    49                                                   // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    50                                                   task run_phase(uvm_phase phase);
    51                                                       phase.raise_objection(this, "test running");
    52                                                       configure_scoreboard();
    53                                                       run_sequences();
    54                                                       #100;
    55                                                       env.agent.monitor.publish_stats();
    56                                                       phase.drop_objection(this, "test done");
    57                                                   endtask
    58                                               
    59                                                   virtual task run_sequences();
    60                                                       `uvm_fatal("BASE","run_sequences() not implemented")
    61                                                   endtask
    62                                               
    63                                               endclass
    64

    302                                              class riscv_regression_test extends riscv_base_test;
    303                                                  `uvm_component_utils(riscv_regression_test)
    304                                              
    305                                                  function new(string name, uvm_component parent);
    306                                                      super.new(name, parent);
    307                                                  endfunction
    308                                              
    309                                                  function void apply_config();
    310                                                      
    311                                                      cfg.stim_mode     = riscv_env_config::RANDOM_PROGRAM;
    312                                                      cfg.run_cycles    = 500000;
    313                                                      cfg.min_ipc       = 0.0;    // checked per-sequence
    314                                                      cfg.enable_ipc_check  = 0;
    315                                                      cfg.track_mispredicts = 1;
    316                                                      cfg.enable_reg_checks = 1;
    317                                                      cfg.enable_mem_checks = 1;
    318                                                      cfg.detailed_cache_stats = 1;
    319                                                      cfg.verbosity     = UVM_LOW;
    320                                                  endfunction
    321                                              
    322                                                  function void configure_scoreboard();
    323                                                      env.scoreboard.expected = riscv_seq_item::type_id::create("exp");
    324                                                      // Sentinel set only for the directed phase
    325                                                      env.scoreboard.expected.exp_int_regs[30] = 32'hX;  // don't care initially
    326                                                  endfunction
    327                                              
    328                                                  task run_sequences();
    329                                                      // Phase 1: directed hex
    330                                                      begin
    331                                                          riscv_full_test_seq seq;
    332                                                          `uvm_info("TEST","== Regression Phase 1: Directed hex ==",UVM_NONE)
    333                                                          env.scoreboard.expected.exp_int_regs[30] = 32'h0DEADBEF;
    334                                                          seq = riscv_full_test_seq::type_id::create("p1");
    335                                                          seq.start(env.agent.sequencer);
    336                                                          env.scoreboard.expected.exp_int_regs[30] = 32'hX;
    337                                                      end
    338                                                      env.scoreboard.prologue_checked = 0;
    339                                                      env.scoreboard.reg_write_count  = 0;
    340                                                      // Phase 2: int ALU random
    341                                                      begin
    342                                                          riscv_int_alu_seq seq;
    343                                                          `uvm_info("TEST","== Regression Phase 2: Int ALU ==",UVM_NONE)
    344                                                          seq = riscv_int_alu_seq::type_id::create("p2");
    345                                                          seq.start(env.agent.sequencer);
    346                                                      end
    347                                                      env.scoreboard.prologue_checked = 0;
    348                                              env.scoreboard.reg_write_count  = 0;
    349                                                      // Phase 3: load/store
    350                                                      begin
    351                                                          riscv_load_store_seq seq;
    352                                                          `uvm_info("TEST","== Regression Phase 3: Load/Store ==",UVM_NONE)
    353                                                          seq = riscv_load_store_seq::type_id::create("p3");
    354                                                          seq.start(env.agent.sequencer);
    355                                                      end
    356                                              env.scoreboard.prologue_checked = 0;
    357                                              env.scoreboard.reg_write_count  = 0;
    358                                                      // Phase 4: branch stress
    359                                                      begin
    360                                                          riscv_branch_stress_seq seq;
    361                                                          `uvm_info("TEST","== Regression Phase 4: Branch ==",UVM_NONE)
    362                                                          seq = riscv_branch_stress_seq::type_id::create("p4");
    363                                                          seq.start(env.agent.sequencer);
    364                                                      end
    365                                              
    366                                                      // Phase 5: FPU
    367                                                      begin
    368                                                          riscv_fpu_seq seq;
    369                                                          `uvm_info("TEST","== Regression Phase 5: FPU ==",UVM_NONE)
    370                                                          seq = riscv_fpu_seq::type_id::create("p5");
    371                                                          seq.start(env.agent.sequencer);
    372                                                      end
    373                                              env.scoreboard.prologue_checked = 0;
    374                                              env.scoreboard.reg_write_count  = 0;
    375                                                      // Phase 6: reset stress
    376                                                      begin
    377                                                          riscv_reset_stress_seq seq;
    378                                                          `uvm_info("TEST","== Regression Phase 6: Reset stress ==",UVM_NONE)
    379                                                          seq = riscv_reset_stress_seq::type_id::create("p6");
    380                                                          seq.iterations = 3;
    381                                                          seq.start(env.agent.sequencer);
    382                                                      end
    383                                                  endtask
    384                                              
    385                                              endclass
    5                                                    `uvm_component_utils(riscv_base_test)
    6                                                
    7                                                    riscv_env        env;
    8                                                    riscv_env_config cfg;
    9                                                 virtual riscv_if vif;
    10                                                   function new(string name, uvm_component parent);
    11                                                       super.new(name, parent);
    12                                                   endfunction
    13                                               
    14                                                 
    15                                                   function void build_phase(uvm_phase phase);
    16                                                      
    17                                               
    18                                                       // 1. Create config object
    19                                                       cfg = riscv_env_config::type_id::create("cfg");
    20                                               
    21                                                       // 2. Pull vif from config_db (set by tb_top)
    22                                                       if (!uvm_config_db #(virtual riscv_if)::get(this, "", "vif", vif))
    23                                                           `uvm_fatal("NOVIF", "riscv_base_test: vif not in config_db")
    24                                                       cfg.vif = vif;
    25                                               
    26                                                       // 3. Apply defaults — child overrides these before calling super
    27                                                       apply_config();
    28                                               
    29                                                       // 4. Validate knobs
    30                                                       cfg.validate();
    31                                               
    32                                                       // 5. Push into config_db so env + all children can get it
    33                                                       uvm_config_db #(riscv_env_config)::set(this, "env*", "cfg", cfg);
    34                                               
    35                                                       // 6. Now build env (it will find cfg in config_db)
    36                                                       super.build_phase(phase);
    37                                                       env = riscv_env::type_id::create("env", this);
    38                                                   endfunction
    39                                               
    40                                                   // Override in child to set cfg fields
    41                                                   virtual function void apply_config();
    42                                                       // base defaults are already set in riscv_env_config constructor
    43                                                   endfunction
    44                                               
    45                                                   // Override in child to set scoreboard expected values
    46                                                   virtual function void configure_scoreboard();
    47                                                   endfunction
    48                                               
    49                                                   // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    50                                                   task run_phase(uvm_phase phase);
    51                                                       phase.raise_objection(this, "test running");
    52                                                       configure_scoreboard();
    53                                                       run_sequences();
    54                                                       #100;
    55                                                       env.agent.monitor.publish_stats();
    56                                                       phase.drop_objection(this, "test done");
    57                                                   endtask
    58                                               
    59                                                   virtual task run_sequences();
    60                                                       `uvm_fatal("BASE","run_sequences() not implemented")
    61                                                   endtask
    62                                               
    63                                               endclass
    64

    356                                              env.scoreboard.prologue_checked = 0;
    357                                              env.scoreboard.reg_write_count  = 0;
    358                                                      // Phase 4: branch stress
    359                                                      begin
    360                                                          riscv_branch_stress_seq seq;
    361                                                          `uvm_info("TEST","== Regression Phase 4: Branch ==",UVM_NONE)
    362                                                          seq = riscv_branch_stress_seq::type_id::create("p4");
    363                                                          seq.start(env.agent.sequencer);
    364                                                      end
    365                                              
    366                                                      // Phase 5: FPU
    367                                                      begin
    368                                                          riscv_fpu_seq seq;
    369                                                          `uvm_info("TEST","== Regression Phase 5: FPU ==",UVM_NONE)
    370                                                          seq = riscv_fpu_seq::type_id::create("p5");
    371                                                          seq.start(env.agent.sequencer);
    372                                                      end
    373                                              env.scoreboard.prologue_checked = 0;
    374                                              env.scoreboard.reg_write_count  = 0;
    375                                                      // Phase 6: reset stress
    376                                                      begin
    377                                                          riscv_reset_stress_seq seq;
    378                                                          `uvm_info("TEST","== Regression Phase 6: Reset stress ==",UVM_NONE)
    379                                                          seq = riscv_reset_stress_seq::type_id::create("p6");
    380                                                          seq.iterations = 3;
    381                                                          seq.start(env.agent.sequencer);
    382                                                      end
    383                                                  endtask
    384                                              
    385                                              endclass
    5                                                    `uvm_component_utils(riscv_base_test)
    6                                                
    7                                                    riscv_env        env;
    8                                                    riscv_env_config cfg;
    9                                                 virtual riscv_if vif;
    10                                                   function new(string name, uvm_component parent);
    11                                                       super.new(name, parent);
    12                                                   endfunction
    13                                               
    14                                                 
    15                                                   function void build_phase(uvm_phase phase);
    16                                                      
    17                                               
    18                                                       // 1. Create config object
    19                                                       cfg = riscv_env_config::type_id::create("cfg");
    20                                               
    21                                                       // 2. Pull vif from config_db (set by tb_top)
    22                                                       if (!uvm_config_db #(virtual riscv_if)::get(this, "", "vif", vif))
    23                                                           `uvm_fatal("NOVIF", "riscv_base_test: vif not in config_db")
    24                                                       cfg.vif = vif;
    25                                               
    26                                                       // 3. Apply defaults — child overrides these before calling super
    27                                                       apply_config();
    28                                               
    29                                                       // 4. Validate knobs
    30                                                       cfg.validate();
    31                                               
    32                                                       // 5. Push into config_db so env + all children can get it
    33                                                       uvm_config_db #(riscv_env_config)::set(this, "env*", "cfg", cfg);
    34                                               
    35                                                       // 6. Now build env (it will find cfg in config_db)
    36                                                       super.build_phase(phase);
    37                                                       env = riscv_env::type_id::create("env", this);
    38                                                   endfunction
    39                                               
    40                                                   // Override in child to set cfg fields
    41                                                   virtual function void apply_config();
    42                                                       // base defaults are already set in riscv_env_config constructor
    43                                                   endfunction
    44                                               
    45                                                   // Override in child to set scoreboard expected values
    46                                                   virtual function void configure_scoreboard();
    47                                                   endfunction
    48                                               
    49                                                   // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    50                                                   task run_phase(uvm_phase phase);
    51                                                       phase.raise_objection(this, "test running");
    52                                                       configure_scoreboard();
    53                                                       run_sequences();
    54                                                       #100;
    55                                                       env.agent.monitor.publish_stats();
    56                                                       phase.drop_objection(this, "test done");
    57                                                   endtask
    58                                               
    59                                                   virtual task run_sequences();
    60                                                       `uvm_fatal("BASE","run_sequences() not implemented")
    61                                                   endtask
    62                                               
    63                                               endclass

    302                                              class riscv_regression_test extends riscv_base_test;
    303                                                  `uvm_component_utils(riscv_regression_test)
    304                                              
    305                                                  function new(string name, uvm_component parent);
    306                                                      super.new(name, parent);
    307                                                  endfunction
    308                                              
    309                                                  function void apply_config();
    310                                                      
    311                                                      cfg.stim_mode     = riscv_env_config::RANDOM_PROGRAM;
    312                                                      cfg.run_cycles    = 500000;
    313                                                      cfg.min_ipc       = 0.0;    // checked per-sequence
    314                                                      cfg.enable_ipc_check  = 0;
    315                                                      cfg.track_mispredicts = 1;
    316                                                      cfg.enable_reg_checks = 1;
    317                                                      cfg.enable_mem_checks = 1;
    318                                                      cfg.detailed_cache_stats = 1;
    319                                                      cfg.verbosity     = UVM_LOW;
    320                                                  endfunction
    321                                              
    322                                                  function void configure_scoreboard();
    323                                                      env.scoreboard.expected = riscv_seq_item::type_id::create("exp");
    324                                                      // Sentinel set only for the directed phase
    325                                                      env.scoreboard.expected.exp_int_regs[30] = 32'hX;  // don't care initially
    326                                                  endfunction
    327                                              
    328                                                  task run_sequences();
    329                                                      // Phase 1: directed hex
    330                                                      begin
    331                                                          riscv_full_test_seq seq;
    332                                                          `uvm_info("TEST","== Regression Phase 1: Directed hex ==",UVM_NONE)
    333                                                          env.scoreboard.expected.exp_int_regs[30] = 32'h0DEADBEF;
    334                                                          seq = riscv_full_test_seq::type_id::create("p1");
    335                                                          seq.start(env.agent.sequencer);
    336                                                          env.scoreboard.expected.exp_int_regs[30] = 32'hX;
    337                                                      end
    338                                                      env.scoreboard.prologue_checked = 0;
    339                                                      env.scoreboard.reg_write_count  = 0;
    340                                                      // Phase 2: int ALU random
    341                                                      begin
    342                                                          riscv_int_alu_seq seq;
    343                                                          `uvm_info("TEST","== Regression Phase 2: Int ALU ==",UVM_NONE)
    344                                                          seq = riscv_int_alu_seq::type_id::create("p2");
    345                                                          seq.start(env.agent.sequencer);
    346                                                      end
    347                                                      env.scoreboard.prologue_checked = 0;
    348                                              env.scoreboard.reg_write_count  = 0;
    349                                                      // Phase 3: load/store
    350                                                      begin
    351                                                          riscv_load_store_seq seq;
    352                                                          `uvm_info("TEST","== Regression Phase 3: Load/Store ==",UVM_NONE)
    353                                                          seq = riscv_load_store_seq::type_id::create("p3");
    354                                                          seq.start(env.agent.sequencer);
    355                                                      end
    356                                              env.scoreboard.prologue_checked = 0;
    357                                              env.scoreboard.reg_write_count  = 0;
    358                                                      // Phase 4: branch stress
    359                                                      begin
    360                                                          riscv_branch_stress_seq seq;
    361                                                          `uvm_info("TEST","== Regression Phase 4: Branch ==",UVM_NONE)
    362                                                          seq = riscv_branch_stress_seq::type_id::create("p4");
    363                                                          seq.start(env.agent.sequencer);
    364                                                      end
    365                                              
    366                                                      // Phase 5: FPU
    367                                                      begin
    368                                                          riscv_fpu_seq seq;
    369                                                          `uvm_info("TEST","== Regression Phase 5: FPU ==",UVM_NONE)
    370                                                          seq = riscv_fpu_seq::type_id::create("p5");
    371                                                          seq.start(env.agent.sequencer);
    372                                                      end
    373                                              env.scoreboard.prologue_checked = 0;
    374                                              env.scoreboard.reg_write_count  = 0;
    375                                                      // Phase 6: reset stress
    376                                                      begin
    377                                                          riscv_reset_stress_seq seq;
    378                                                          `uvm_info("TEST","== Regression Phase 6: Reset stress ==",UVM_NONE)
    379                                                          seq = riscv_reset_stress_seq::type_id::create("p6");
    380                                                          seq.iterations = 3;
    381                                                          seq.start(env.agent.sequencer);
    382                                                      end
    383                                                  endtask
    384                                              
    385                                              endclass

    302                                              class riscv_regression_test extends riscv_base_test;
    303                                                  `uvm_component_utils(riscv_regression_test)
    304                                              
    305                                                  function new(string name, uvm_component parent);
    306                                                      super.new(name, parent);
    307                                                  endfunction
    308                                              
    309                                                  function void apply_config();
    310                                                      
    311                                                      cfg.stim_mode     = riscv_env_config::RANDOM_PROGRAM;
    312                                                      cfg.run_cycles    = 500000;
    313                                                      cfg.min_ipc       = 0.0;    // checked per-sequence
    314                                                      cfg.enable_ipc_check  = 0;
    315                                                      cfg.track_mispredicts = 1;
    316                                                      cfg.enable_reg_checks = 1;
    317                                                      cfg.enable_mem_checks = 1;
    318                                                      cfg.detailed_cache_stats = 1;
    319                                                      cfg.verbosity     = UVM_LOW;
    320                                                  endfunction
    321                                              
    322                                                  function void configure_scoreboard();
    323                                                      env.scoreboard.expected = riscv_seq_item::type_id::create("exp");
    324                                                      // Sentinel set only for the directed phase
    325                                                      env.scoreboard.expected.exp_int_regs[30] = 32'hX;  // don't care initially
    326                                                  endfunction
    327                                              
    328                                                  task run_sequences();
    329                                                      // Phase 1: directed hex
    330                                                      begin
    331                                                          riscv_full_test_seq seq;
    332                                                          `uvm_info("TEST","== Regression Phase 1: Directed hex ==",UVM_NONE)
    333                                                          env.scoreboard.expected.exp_int_regs[30] = 32'h0DEADBEF;
    334                                                          seq = riscv_full_test_seq::type_id::create("p1");
    335                                                          seq.start(env.agent.sequencer);
    336                                                          env.scoreboard.expected.exp_int_regs[30] = 32'hX;
    337                                                      end
    338                                                      env.scoreboard.prologue_checked = 0;
    339                                                      env.scoreboard.reg_write_count  = 0;
    340                                                      // Phase 2: int ALU random
    341                                                      begin
    342                                                          riscv_int_alu_seq seq;
    343                                                          `uvm_info("TEST","== Regression Phase 2: Int ALU ==",UVM_NONE)
    344                                                          seq = riscv_int_alu_seq::type_id::create("p2");
    345                                                          seq.start(env.agent.sequencer);
    346                                                      end
    347                                                      env.scoreboard.prologue_checked = 0;
    348                                              env.scoreboard.reg_write_count  = 0;
    349                                                      // Phase 3: load/store
    350                                                      begin
    351                                                          riscv_load_store_seq seq;
    352                                                          `uvm_info("TEST","== Regression Phase 3: Load/Store ==",UVM_NONE)
    353                                                          seq = riscv_load_store_seq::type_id::create("p3");
    354                                                          seq.start(env.agent.sequencer);
    355                                                      end
    356                                              env.scoreboard.prologue_checked = 0;
    357                                              env.scoreboard.reg_write_count  = 0;
    358                                                      // Phase 4: branch stress
    359                                                      begin
    360                                                          riscv_branch_stress_seq seq;
    361                                                          `uvm_info("TEST","== Regression Phase 4: Branch ==",UVM_NONE)
    362                                                          seq = riscv_branch_stress_seq::type_id::create("p4");
    363                                                          seq.start(env.agent.sequencer);
    364                                                      end
    365                                              
    366                                                      // Phase 5: FPU
    367                                                      begin
    368                                                          riscv_fpu_seq seq;
    369                                                          `uvm_info("TEST","== Regression Phase 5: FPU ==",UVM_NONE)
    370                                                          seq = riscv_fpu_seq::type_id::create("p5");
    371                                                          seq.start(env.agent.sequencer);
    372                                                      end
    373                                              env.scoreboard.prologue_checked = 0;
    374                                              env.scoreboard.reg_write_count  = 0;
    375                                                      // Phase 6: reset stress
    376                                                      begin
    377                                                          riscv_reset_stress_seq seq;
    378                                                          `uvm_info("TEST","== Regression Phase 6: Reset stress ==",UVM_NONE)
    379                                                          seq = riscv_reset_stress_seq::type_id::create("p6");
    380                                                          seq.iterations = 3;
    381                                                          seq.start(env.agent.sequencer);
    382                                                      end
    383                                                  endtask
    384                                              
    385                                              endclass
    5                                                    `uvm_component_utils(riscv_base_test)
    6                                                
    7                                                    riscv_env        env;
    8                                                    riscv_env_config cfg;
    9                                                 virtual riscv_if vif;
    10                                                   function new(string name, uvm_component parent);
    11                                                       super.new(name, parent);
    12                                                   endfunction
    13                                               
    14                                                 
    15                                                   function void build_phase(uvm_phase phase);
    16                                                      
    17                                               
    18                                                       // 1. Create config object
    19                                                       cfg = riscv_env_config::type_id::create("cfg");
    20                                               
    21                                                       // 2. Pull vif from config_db (set by tb_top)
    22                                                       if (!uvm_config_db #(virtual riscv_if)::get(this, "", "vif", vif))
    23                                                           `uvm_fatal("NOVIF", "riscv_base_test: vif not in config_db")
    24                                                       cfg.vif = vif;
    25                                               
    26                                                       // 3. Apply defaults — child overrides these before calling super
    27                                                       apply_config();
    28                                               
    29                                                       // 4. Validate knobs
    30                                                       cfg.validate();
    31                                               
    32                                                       // 5. Push into config_db so env + all children can get it
    33                                                       uvm_config_db #(riscv_env_config)::set(this, "env*", "cfg", cfg);
    34                                               
    35                                                       // 6. Now build env (it will find cfg in config_db)
    36                                                       super.build_phase(phase);
    37                                                       env = riscv_env::type_id::create("env", this);
    38                                                   endfunction
    39                                               
    40                                                   // Override in child to set cfg fields
    41                                                   virtual function void apply_config();
    42                                                       // base defaults are already set in riscv_env_config constructor
    43                                                   endfunction
    44                                               
    45                                                   // Override in child to set scoreboard expected values
    46                                                   virtual function void configure_scoreboard();
    47                                                   endfunction
    48                                               
    49                                                   // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    50                                                   task run_phase(uvm_phase phase);
    51                                                       phase.raise_objection(this, "test running");
    52                                                       configure_scoreboard();
    53                                                       run_sequences();
    54                                                       #100;
    55                                                       env.agent.monitor.publish_stats();
    56                                                       phase.drop_objection(this, "test done");
    57                                                   endtask
    58                                               
    59                                                   virtual task run_sequences();
    60                                                       `uvm_fatal("BASE","run_sequences() not implemented")
    61                                                   endtask
    62                                               
    63                                               endclass
    64
